items.name: image-cropper

items.name: data-table

items.name: form-wizard

items.name: file-upload-list

items.name: checkbox-tree

items.name: masked-input

items.name: filter-bar

items.name: emoji-picker
items.title: Emoji Picker
items.description: A full emoji panel — 554 built-in emoji in 8 categories with bilingual search, skin tones, recents and a windowed arrow-key grid, inline or portalled beside a trigger.

items.name: form-field
items.title: Form Field

items.name: credit-card-form

items.name: availability-picker
items.title: Availability Picker
items.description: A week × time-slot grid you brush to declare when you are free — paint/erase drag strokes, keyboard painting, blocked slots and an optional group heatmap.

items.name: kanban-board
items.title: Kanban Board
items.description: A contract-driven kanban board — dnd-kit drag and drop across and within columns, keyboard-accessible moves with live announcements, WIP limits that block over-filling, per-column scrolling, and real loading/empty/error states.

items.name: schedule-calendar
items.title: Schedule Calendar
items.description: A day/week time grid — events placed by the minute, overlapping ones packed side by side, an all-day row, a caller-supplied current-time line, click-to-create slots and real loading/empty/error states.

items.name: notification-center
items.title: Notification Center
items.description: An inbox popover for the app bell — grouped rows, tab filters, per-row and bulk read management, clipping-aware placement, and real loading/empty/error states.

items.name: log-viewer
items.title: Log Viewer
items.description: A runtime log console — level filters with counts, search highlighting with hit-to-hit jumps, tail-follow that pauses on manual scroll, and windowed rendering for huge buffers.

items.name: comment-thread
items.title: Comment Thread
items.description: A nested discussion tree — collapsible reply subtrees on a clickable thread line, optimistic voting, inline reply composer with a posting/failed lifecycle, controlled sorting, and a depth cap that hands deep threads off to a permalink.

items.name: chat-thread
items.title: Chat Thread
items.description: A contract-driven conversation stream — sender grouping, day and unread dividers, streaming append, load-older with position kept, and a scroll that never gets stolen from the reader.

items.name: profile-card
items.title: Profile Card
items.description: One person card in three densities — vertical, horizontal and compact — with presence dot, badges, stats, a stretched-link name and initials fallback.

items.name: rating-summary
items.title: Rating Summary
items.description: A read-only review digest: average score, fractional stars and five distribution bars that double as star-filter toggles, plus a no-reviews state.

items.name: product-card
items.title: Product Card
items.description: A storefront product card: one stretched link over the whole card, variant swatches that swap the photo, a discount derived from the was-price, a sold-out veil and a four-phase Add to cart that never fakes success.

items.name: diff-viewer
items.title: Diff Viewer
items.description: A GitHub-style text diff — unified or side-by-side, own LCS line matching with word-level highlights, foldable context, a pinned line-number gutter and guards for huge inputs.

items.name: uptime-bars
items.title: Uptime Bars
items.description: A status-page availability strip — one bar per day bucketed into operational / degraded / partial / major, with hover-or-focus incident detail and a width-aware day window.

items.name: steps-checklist
items.title: Steps Checklist
items.description: An onboarding checklist that tracks setup progress — togglable steps with optional CTAs, expandable detail, a progress meter and a completion celebration.

items.name: split-pane
items.title: Split Pane
items.description: A dependency-free resizable split layout — percentage flex-basis panes, percent or px per-pane minimums, double-click collapse, full keyboard resizing and an optional persisted layout.

items.name: settings-list
items.title: Settings List
items.description: Grouped settings rows — label and description on the left, your own control on the right, with whole-row links, badges, disabled rows and a danger zone.

items.name: scroll-area
items.title: Scroll Area
items.description: A themed scroll container that keeps native scrolling untouched — the platform bar is hidden and a draggable thumb is drawn from scrollTop/scrollHeight, with edge fades and an end-reached callback.

items.name: drawer
items.title: Drawer
items.description: A gesture-driven drawer for any edge — snap points, velocity-based settling, scroll-aware pull-to-close, focus trap and refcounted scroll lock. No vaul.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: A click-triggered floating panel that portals past clipping ancestors, then flips, shifts and size-caps itself against the nearest scrollable boundary.

items.name: hover-card
items.title: Hover Card
items.description: A hover-and-focus card for arbitrary rich content — avatar, stats, links, buttons — with an open delay, a close grace period the pointer can cross into, clip-aware flipping and tap-to-toggle on touch.

items.name: feedback-widget
items.title: Feedback Widget
items.description: A corner or inline feedback launcher with a sentiment radiogroup, category chips, message and optional email, driven by an idle → submitting → success → error submit state machine.

items.name: loading-overlay
items.title: Loading Overlay
items.description: A scrim that freezes one region or the whole viewport while work is in flight — delay-gated so short requests never flash, held for a minimum so it never blinks out, and inert underneath so Tab cannot walk into the frozen form.

items.name: shortcuts-dialog
items.title: Shortcuts Dialog
items.description: A grouped keyboard cheat sheet bound to the ? key — platform-correct keycap glyphs, token-based filtering, focus trap and a refcounted scroll lock.

items.name: top-loading-bar
items.title: Top Loading Bar
items.description: A thin route and request bar that climbs asymptotically towards 99% while work is in flight — delay-gated so fast requests never flash, held for a minimum duration, with a controlled mode, top or bottom placement and an optional spinner.

items.name: error-boundary
items.title: Error Boundary
items.description: A real React error boundary — keyed remount on reset, automatic recovery when resetKeys change, a consecutive-failure guard, onError reporting with the component stack, and dev-only stack details.

items.name: mega-menu
items.title: Mega Menu
items.description: A site nav bar whose entries drop a wide multi-column sheet across the whole navbar — portalled past clipping ancestors, hover intent with instant lateral switching, and an automatic accordion fallback.

items.name: context-menu
items.title: Context Menu
items.description: Right-click, long-press or Shift+F10 menu that opens at the pointer — checkboxes, submenus, typeahead, and flipping bounded by the nearest clipping ancestor.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown Menu
items.description: A generic dropdown menu — any trigger, structured rows (commands, checkboxes, radio groups, submenus), typeahead and clipping-aware placement.

items.name: video-player
items.title: Video Player
items.description: A custom control skin for a self-hosted <video> — pointer-capture scrubbing with preview time, buffered ranges, volume memory, speed menu, subtitles, fullscreen, PiP, keyboard shortcuts and a readable error state.

items.name: video-hover-preview
items.title: Video Hover Preview
items.description: A thumbnail card that plays a muted preview clip on hover or keyboard focus — delayed lazy load, pointer-x scrubbing, progress bar, and a poster fallback on error.

items.name: camera-capture
items.title: Camera Capture
items.description: A real getUserMedia webcam capturer — live preview, countdown shutter, mirrored canvas export, and a keep/retake review that returns a JPEG Blob.

items.name: particles
items.title: Particles
items.description: An interactive canvas particle field — dots, linked constellations, snow or fireflies that follow your text token and scatter from the pointer.

items.name: use-async
items.title: useAsync
items.description: A one-call async state machine with last-call-wins race protection, AbortSignal cancellation and unmount-safe resolves.

items.name: use-drag-scroll
items.title: useDragScroll
items.description: Grab-to-scroll any overflow container with pointer drags — momentum glide, grabbing cursor, and click suppression so dragging over a card never fires its onClick.

items.name: use-long-press
items.title: useLongPress
items.description: A press-and-hold gesture hook returning spreadable pointer/keyboard handlers plus isPressing and 0–1 progress — pointer-captured, cancels past a move tolerance, works with held Space/Enter.

items.name: use-swipe
items.title: useSwipe
items.description: A Pointer Events swipe hook with axis/direction locking, distance-or-velocity commit and live follow-the-finger deltas — spread its props, animate the offset yourself.

items.name: use-resize-observer
items.title: useResizeObserver
items.description: A callback-ref hook that measures an element's own size with ResizeObserver — selectable box model, rAF-batched or debounced commits, and no resize-loop errors.

items.name: use-geolocation
items.title: useGeolocation
items.description: Reads or continuously watches the browser's geolocation behind an explicit request()/stop() pair, with hydration-safe capability detection, a queried permission state, and separate denied / timeout / position-unavailable / unsupported outcomes.

items.name: use-page-visibility
items.title: usePageVisibility
items.description: Subscribes to page visibility via useSyncExternalStore so polling, timers and video pause when the tab is hidden, with onVisible/onHidden callbacks and the away duration.

items.name: use-broadcast-channel
items.title: useBroadcastChannel
items.description: Broadcasts messages between same-origin tabs over BroadcastChannel, with SSR-safe capability detection, an optional local echo and structured-clone diagnostics.

items.name: use-undo-redo
items.title: useUndoRedo
items.description: A state container with linear undo/redo history — keystroke coalescing, forced breakpoints, a bounded stack, and stable callbacks.

items.name: use-controllable-state
items.title: useControllableState
items.description: A useState-shaped hook that lets one component serve both controlled (value/onChange) and uncontrolled (defaultValue) callers, with a stable setter and prop-accurate updaters.

items.name: package-info
items.title: Package Info
items.description: Display package versions, dependency groups, and upgrade status in a compact metadata panel.

items.name: announcement
items.title: Announcement
items.description: A compact inline announcement link with an optional label, icon and directional CTA cue.

items.name: border-trace-button
items.title: Border Trace Button
items.description: A native button with an animated border trace and reduced-motion fallback.

items.name: animated-beam
items.title: Animated Beam
items.description: Connect two interface nodes with a responsive animated SVG beam.

items.name: flickering-grid
items.title: Flickering Grid
items.description: Render a responsive canvas grid with subtle, reduced-motion-aware flickering cells.

items.name: environment-variables
items.title: Environment Variables
items.description: Review, reveal, and copy environment variables with sensitive values masked by default.

items.name: test-results
items.title: Test Results
items.description: Summarize test suites, outcomes, durations, and failure details across explicit data states.

items.name: schema-display
items.title: Schema Display
items.description: Document API operations, parameters, and nested schemas in an accessible expandable view.

items.name: stack-trace
items.title: Stack Trace
items.description: Parse, inspect, and copy stack traces while preserving unrecognized raw frames.

items.name: perspective-marquee
items.title: 3D Marquee
items.description: Present media tiles in a responsive perspective marquee with explicit data states.

items.name: slug-input
items.title: Slug Input
items.description: A URL field that transliterates the title as you type, detaches the moment you edit it by hand, and debounces an availability check with clickable -2 / -3 suggestions.

items.name: unit-input
items.title: Unit Input
items.description: A number-plus-unit field for design tokens — 12px, 1.5rem, 50% — with arrow/wheel stepping, optional conversion on unit switch, and an auto state.

items.name: repeater-field
items.title: Repeater Field
items.description: A generic controlled array field — add, remove, move and drag-sort rows of any shape, with min/max clamping and stable row ids that never remount a focused input.

items.name: timezone-picker
items.title: Timezone Picker
items.description: A searchable IANA time-zone field — ~90 zones grouped Popular / All, each row showing that zone's live local time and derived GMT offset, in a portalled panel no overflow-hidden card can clip.

items.name: cron-input
items.title: Cron Input
items.description: A visual five-field cron builder — presets, hour/minute selects and weekday/month chips write the expression, pasting one parses back into them, with a plain-English summary and the next runs.

items.name: leaderboard
items.title: Leaderboard
items.description: A ranked standings board — podium tiers, rank-change arrows, a highlighted current-user row with a pinned "your rank" bar, and real loading/empty/error states.

items.name: invoice-summary
items.title: Invoice Summary
items.description: An invoice / order total block — line items (quantity × unit), discounts, taxes with rates, shipping, total and amount due, all in integer minor units, with full and compact variants and four data states.

items.name: request-waterfall
items.title: Request Waterfall
items.description: A DevTools-style network waterfall — one adaptive time axis, bars segmented by DNS/connect/TLS/TTFB/download, hover-or-focus phase breakdowns, duration sorting, and real loading/empty/error states.

items.name: org-chart
items.title: Org Chart
items.description: A recursive org/hierarchy chart drawn with pure-CSS connector lines (sibling bus trimmed at both ends), collapsible subtrees, vertical or horizontal orientation, renderNode-swappable cards, and a keyboard-navigable WAI-ARIA tree that scrolls inside its own box instead of overflowing.

items.name: api-endpoint
items.title: API Endpoint
items.description: A collapsible API reference card with a monochrome-safe method badge, grouped parameter tables, expandable response examples, and a generated Copy-as-cURL command that reports failure honestly.

items.name: save-indicator
items.title: Save Indicator
items.description: Autosave status line for an editor toolbar — Saving… holds a minimum beat to avoid flicker, Saved fades back into "Last saved 3 minutes ago", and errors stay put with a Retry.

items.name: permission-prompt
items.title: Permission Prompt
items.description: A pre-permission explainer card that says why camera, microphone, location, notification or clipboard access is needed before the browser's one-shot dialog is spent, with per-permission recovery steps and a retry once it's blocked.

items.name: connection-status
items.title: Connection Status
items.description: An online / offline / reconnecting bar with an exponential-backoff retry countdown, a manual retry button and SSR-safe browser subscription.

items.name: workspace-switcher
items.title: Workspace Switcher
items.description: A workspace / organization switcher: active workspace in the trigger, grouped searchable menu in a portalled panel, pinned create and settings footer.

items.name: image-annotation
items.title: Image Annotation
items.description: Click-to-pin image annotation — numbered draggable markers with notes, stored as percentages of the image so they never drift when it resizes.

items.name: redacted-text
items.title: Redacted Text
items.description: Blur, black-bar or character-mask a sensitive string with hover / click / press-and-hold reveal — where mask actually removes the plaintext from the DOM.

items.name: ripple-rings
items.title: Ripple Rings
items.description: Concentric ripples expanding out of one origin — a pure CSS/DOM backdrop with an optional pointer-following origin and a static reduced-motion fallback.

items.name: topography
items.title: Topography
items.description: A seamlessly tiling contour-map backdrop traced from seeded hash noise — quiet relief lines for docs shells, auth screens and empty states.

items.name: use-selection
items.title: useSelection
items.description: A list multi-selection state machine with Shift range, platform-aware cmd/ctrl toggle, tri-state select-all flags, and automatic pruning when items change.

items.name: use-pagination
items.title: usePagination
items.description: Headless pagination state — clamped page, page count, item range, client-side slice() and the ellipsis page sequence, controlled or uncontrolled.

items.name: address-form
items.title: Address Form
items.description: A postal address form driven by a country rule table: per-country field set, field order and labels, state dropdown or free text or nothing, postal codes that are required, optional or absent, blur-time validation, correct autocomplete tokens, and an announced clear when a value cannot follow you to the next country.

items.name: rich-text-toolbar
items.title: Rich Text Toolbar
items.description: An editor-agnostic formatting bar: grouped toggle buttons that never steal the editor's selection, collapse into an overflow menu by measurement, and walk on a single tab stop — plus a floating variant that follows the selection.

items.name: json-editor
items.title: JSON Editor
items.description: An editable JSON textarea with live syntax validation, exact line/column errors marked in a synced gutter, optional schema checking, and format/minify/copy/reset tools.

items.name: query-builder
items.title: Query Builder
items.description: A recursive AND/OR condition tree — operator menus follow the field's type, any condition can be turned into a nested group up to a depth cap, and a read-only SQL-ish expression shows what the tree means.

items.name: pin-pad
items.title: Pin Pad
items.description: A touch-first numeric keypad for PIN entry: 44px keys, masked dot indicator, deterministic shuffled layout, keyboard parity, and pending/error states.

items.name: percent-allocator
items.title: Percent Allocator
items.description: Split a total across rows with largest-remainder rebalancing, per-row locks and min/max limits — the shares always add up to the target exactly.

items.name: markdown-editor
items.title: Markdown Editor
items.description: A textarea-based Markdown editor with a selection-aware toggling toolbar, ⌘B/⌘I/⌘K shortcuts, write/preview/split modes and a dependency-free preview renderer.

items.name: language-picker
items.title: Language Picker
items.description: A locale field that lists every language under its own name — 简体中文 beside Chinese (Simplified) — searchable by endonym, English name or BCP 47 tag, with RTL rows rendered in their own direction, optional translation completeness and a browser-language matching ladder.

items.name: dimension-input
items.title: Dimension Input
items.description: A paired width × height field with an aspect-ratio lock that freezes the ratio when you lock it, clamps both sides against min/max, and ships swap plus size/ratio presets.

items.name: gradient-picker
items.title: Gradient Picker
items.description: A CSS gradient editor: draggable stop rail with double-click insert, keyboard-reachable stops, an angle dial, and a read-only linear/radial/conic CSS string with copy.

items.name: shortcut-recorder
items.title: Shortcut Recorder
items.description: A field that records a keyboard shortcut by pressing it — swallows every key while recording, waits past the modifiers for a real key, and separates browser-reserved combos (refused) from ones that would override an existing binding (recorded, with a warning).

items.name: gantt-chart
items.title: Gantt Chart
items.description: A project schedule chart — sticky task column, adaptive day/week/month axis, progress-filled bars, milestone diamonds, finish-to-start dependency elbows, collapsible groups, and real loading/empty/error states.

items.name: inbox-list
items.title: Inbox List
items.description: A triage-ready message list — unread by weight and dot, Shift-range multi-select with a bulk bar, keyboard shortcuts, hover-and-focus row actions, and real loading/empty/error states.

items.name: audit-trail
items.title: Audit Trail
items.description: A compliance-grade activity log — one readable sentence per event, day separators, expandable before/after diffs, and real loading/empty/error states.

items.name: permission-matrix
items.title: Permission Matrix
items.description: An editable roles × permissions grid: tri-state cells (allow / deny / inherit), collapsible permission groups, a pinned permission column, locked system-role columns, row/column bulk edits, and real loading/empty/error states.

items.name: data-grid-editable
items.title: Data Grid Editable
items.description: A spreadsheet-style editable data grid — per-column cell editors, roving-tabindex keyboard navigation, per-cell validation, async commits that show pending and roll back, TSV paste, sticky header and first column, plus real loading/empty/error states.

items.name: session-list
items.title: Session List
items.description: Signed-in devices with per-row and bulk sign-out — the current session is highlighted and never revocable, rejected revokes keep the row with a retry, and loading/empty/error are first-class states.

items.name: changelog-list
items.title: Changelog List
items.description: User-facing release notes — one block per version, entries grouped by kind with an icon and a word, a sticky version rail on wide containers and real per-release permalinks.

items.name: tree-map
items.title: Tree Map
items.description: A squarified treemap that tiles a hierarchy by value — nested groups, click-to-drill with a breadcrumb, rank-based shading and keyboard-reachable DOM tiles (no canvas).

items.name: toolbar
items.title: Toolbar
items.description: A grouped application toolbar that measures itself and folds its lowest-priority actions into a portalled "More" menu — no breakpoints, roving tabindex, pressed toggles kept intact.

items.name: version-history
items.title: Version History
items.description: A day-grouped snapshot list — preview a version, compare two, and roll one back behind a real confirmation with pending, failure and retry.

items.name: mini-map
items.title: Mini Map
items.description: A thumbnail navigator for any scroll container — a draggable viewport box over an auto-measured (or custom-drawn) silhouette, kept in sync by a passive rAF-throttled listener that writes transform straight to the DOM.

items.name: inline-error-summary
items.title: Inline Error Summary
items.description: A top-of-form error summary whose rows scroll to and focus the field they name — persistent polite live region, self-focusing panel, onNavigate hook for collapsed fields and a maxVisible overflow count.

items.name: health-check-list
items.title: Health Check List
items.description: A self-diagnostics panel — one independently re-runnable probe per row, shape-plus-word statuses, expandable evidence, real fix actions and a counts-and-verdict summary.

items.name: status-timeline
items.title: Status Timeline
items.description: A read-only progress thread for an async run — per-stage icon + word, live elapsed time on the running stage, expandable failures and a settled-run summary, vertical or horizontal.

items.name: diff-confirm
items.title: Diff Confirm
items.description: A confirmation dialog that shows the change list first — grouped create/update/delete counts, expandable before → after rows, type-to-confirm past a destructive threshold, and a failure state that keeps the plan on screen.

items.name: app-launcher
items.title: App Launcher
items.description: A nine-dot app switcher: a grid button that drops a portalled tile grid of real links, with arrow-key grid navigation, groups, pinned and recent rows, and a search box once the suite outgrows a 3x3.

items.name: nav-rail
items.title: Nav Rail
items.description: A narrow vertical icon navigation bar that widens into a labelled column — keyboard-reachable tooltips, top/bottom zones, badges and a controllable expanded state.

items.name: audio-waveform
items.title: Audio Waveform
items.description: A canvas amplitude waveform with a click/drag/keyboard seek slider — takes precomputed peaks or decodes a src itself, highlights regions, and stays a controlled display while your own audio element plays.

items.name: media-grid-selectable
items.title: Media Grid Selectable
items.description: A multi-select photo/video grid with Shift range, cmd/ctrl toggle, two-dimensional arrow-key navigation, a selection cap, lazy thumbnails and type-icon fallbacks.

items.name: audio-visualizer
items.title: Audio Visualizer
items.description: A real-time AnalyserNode visualizer — spectrum bars, oscilloscope, radial ring or segmented level meter, driven by a stream, an audio element or an analyser you own.

items.name: file-preview
items.title: File Preview
items.description: A preview card for any single file — image/video thumbnails, a working audio play bar, type icons with MIME-or-extension metadata, card/row/tile variants and leak-free object URLs.

items.name: truncate-middle
items.title: Truncate Middle
items.description: Middle-ellipsis text that keeps both ends readable — a fixed head/tail cluster count, or as many characters as the measured width actually fits.

items.name: glitch-text
items.title: Glitch Text
items.description: Cyberpunk glitch headline — two pseudo-element copies tear the text into slices and slide, in pure CSS, dead still under reduced motion.

items.name: search-highlight
items.title: Search Highlight
items.description: Highlights the parts of a text that match a search query — substring, per-word or fuzzy subsequence, with escaped queries, merged overlaps and a current-match cursor.

items.name: starfield
items.title: Starfield
items.description: A layered parallax star field on one canvas — 2-4 depth layers drifting or warping, seeded for a reproducible sky, with a faint-dust fallback on light surfaces.

items.name: hex-grid
items.title: Hex Grid
items.description: A seamlessly tiling honeycomb backdrop — outlined, tinted or vertex-dotted, with an optional edge fade and a few seeded cells breathing on CSS alone.

items.name: circuit-board
items.title: Circuit Board
items.description: A seamlessly tiling PCB backdrop — seeded traces with 45°/90° corners, pads, vias and component footprints, plus an optional signal pulse.

items.name: use-focus-trap
items.title: useFocusTrap
items.description: A hook that keeps keyboard focus inside a container: moves focus in, cycles Tab both ways, only the innermost trap reacts, and focus returns to the trigger on release.

items.name: use-roving-tabindex
items.title: useRovingTabindex
items.description: A roving-tabindex hook that gives a control group one Tab stop and arrow-key navigation inside it — horizontal / vertical / grid lanes, disabled-item skipping, loop or stop, Home/End and typeahead.

items.name: use-permission
items.title: usePermission
items.description: Subscribes to navigator.permissions for one name or a whole panel of them — query only, never request — folding Firefox's rejections, Safari's gaps, unknown names and insecure origins into one honest unsupported state with a reason, plus change-event updates and a manual query().

items.name: use-web-share
items.title: useWebShare
items.description: Opens the native share sheet with typed outcomes — a cancelled sheet is dismissed rather than an error, files are gated behind canShare, and the fallback reports its own success or failure.

items.name: use-speech-recognition
items.title: useSpeechRecognition
items.description: Speech-to-text on the Web Speech API: prefixed-constructor detection, interim vs settled transcripts, a continuous mode that re-arms itself after the engine's silence timeout yet always stops on stop(), and errors split into benign / recoverable / blocked.

items.name: use-mutation-observer
items.title: useMutationObserver
items.description: A callback-ref hook that watches DOM changes with MutationObserver — filtered attributes, rAF-batched records, and a disconnect/write/observe guard against self-feeding loops.

items.name: use-step
items.title: useStep
items.description: A step machine for multi-step flows — async can-go-next gates with a pending flag, visited/completed sets, loop, and clamping when steps change.

items.name: use-list
items.title: useList
items.description: Array state with every mutation you keep hand-writing — push, insertAt, move, swap and keyed upsert, all batch-safe, out-of-range-safe, and reference-stable.

items.name: use-clipboard-paste
items.title: useClipboardPaste
items.description: Catches pasted images, files and rich text — page-wide or scoped to a ref — draining clipboardData synchronously, gating files through accept/maxFiles with an itemised rejection list, plus an optional permission-checked active read.

items.name: use-wake-lock
items.title: useWakeLock
items.description: Keeps the screen awake for the length of a task and re-acquires the wake lock the browser silently takes away whenever the tab is hidden, with gesture-safe requests and distinguishable refusal errors.

items.name: use-hash
items.title: useHash
items.description: An SSR-safe hook that reads and writes the URL hash as shareable UI state, writing through pushState/replaceState and broadcasting to every instance on the page.

items.name: use-notification
items.title: useNotification
items.description: Sends desktop notifications behind a gesture-gated requestPermission() that never throws, keeps the permission state live via the Permissions API, registers each notification by tag so close(tag) works, and skips notifications while the page is visible.

items.name: chart-area-stacked
items.title: Area Chart (Stacked)
items.description: A four-state stacked area chart card whose legend chips toggle single series, re-stacking the survivors and rescaling the y-axis, with a per-series plus total tooltip.

items.name: chart-line-multi
items.title: Multi-Series Line Chart
items.description: A four-state multi-series line chart whose shared crosshair reads every series at the hovered x, ranked by value, with null gaps left broken.

items.name: chart-radial-progress
items.title: Radial Progress Chart
items.description: A four-state radial progress card: one concentric ring per metric against its own target, a summary number in the hole, and over-target rings capped at one lap with truncation marks instead of drawing through.

items.name: chart-funnel
items.title: Funnel Chart
items.description: A four-state conversion funnel: tapering bands with a minimum width, plus per-stage counts, step conversion and cumulative conversion.

items.name: chart-scatter-quadrant
items.title: Scatter Chart (Quadrants)
items.description: A four-state decision-matrix scatter chart: median or fixed crosshair, labelled tinted quadrants, collision fan-out and a screen-reader data table.

items.name: chart-radar-compare
items.title: Radar Comparison Chart
items.description: A four-state radar chart comparing two or three subjects across mixed-unit dimensions: each spoke is normalized 0-100 while the tooltip keeps the raw values.

items.name: chart-waterfall
items.title: Waterfall Chart
items.description: A bridge chart of floating bars — derived opening/subtotal/closing anchors, hatched decreases, running-total connectors, slot-aware ticks and real loading/empty/error states.

items.name: chart-gauge
items.title: Gauge Chart
items.description: A four-state needle dial that reads one metric against contract-driven threshold bands, with explicit boundary attribution and an out-of-range caret.

items.name: chart-bullet
items.title: Bullet Chart
items.description: A four-state bullet chart: one row per KPI with its own scale, a measure bar against a target tick and qualitative bands, plus clamped off-scale markers.

items.name: chart-candlestick
items.title: Candlestick Chart
items.description: A four-state OHLC candlestick chart: hollow-up / solid-down bodies, wicks, doji and limit-locked sessions kept visible, and a full-OHLC tooltip.

items.name: chart-histogram
items.title: Histogram
items.description: A four-state distribution chart that bins raw values itself — auto / fixed-count / fixed-width bins with optional percentile reference lines.

items.name: chart-stacked-bar-pct
items.title: 100% Stacked Bar Chart
items.description: A four-state 100% stacked bar chart with largest-remainder rounding, so every bar's percentages add up to exactly 100.

items.name: chart-step-line
items.title: Step Line Chart
items.description: A four-state step chart for discrete state over time — values hold flat then jump, with three step alignments, change markers and a change table.

items.name: chart-range-area
items.title: Range Area Chart
items.description: A four-state range-area card: a center line inside one or two nested uncertainty bands, with contradictory bounds repaired and disclosed instead of drawn as crossed polygons.

items.name: hero-section
items.title: Hero Section
items.description: A props-driven landing hero with eyebrow, dual CTAs, social-proof bar and an optional visual that collapses to a centred column when omitted.

items.name: feature-grid
items.title: Feature Grid
items.description: A four-state feature section: equal-weight icon cards with optional real "learn more" links, and no cap on how many render.

items.name: cta-band
items.title: CTA Band
items.description: A closing call-to-action strip — headline, supporting line and a primary/secondary CTA pair, in four surfaces (plain, card, muted, accent) and row or stacked layouts.

items.name: logo-cloud
items.title: Logo Cloud
items.description: A trusted-by logo wall that optically equalises logos of wildly different aspect ratios, as a static grid or a reduced-motion-aware marquee.

items.name: newsletter-signup
items.title: Newsletter Signup
items.description: An email capture band driven by a real submit state machine: zod validation, a duplicate-submit guard, a role=status confirmation, an idempotent already-subscribed branch, and a failure that keeps the address you typed.

items.name: site-footer
items.title: Site Footer
items.description: A contract-driven site footer: brand block with named social links, collapsible link columns on mobile, and a legal bottom bar with an optional locale switcher.

items.name: team-grid
items.title: Team Grid
items.description: A four-state team section with equal-height member cards, initials-fallback avatars, real social links and optional department grouping.

items.name: contact-section
items.title: Contact Section
items.description: A contact block built around its submit state machine: zod-validated name/email/topic/message, a duplicate-submit guard, a confirmation panel that names the address it replied to, and a failure that keeps every character you typed — beside contact rows whose mailto:/tel:/map links are derived from their own values.

items.name: blog-card-grid
items.title: Blog Card Grid
items.description: A four-state article grid: one stretched link per card (category and author stay independently clickable), a featured post that spans two columns, and deliberate, configurable line clamping so mismatched title lengths still line up.

items.name: auth-card
items.title: Auth Card
items.description: Sign-in, sign-up and reset in one card: a typed rejection union (bad credentials, address taken, rate limited), per-mode autocomplete tokens, a duplicate-submit guard, and input that survives every failure.

items.name: dashboard-shell
items.title: Dashboard Shell
items.description: An app shell with a pinned top bar, a collapsible icon rail and a main region that is the page's only scroll container — on mobile the sidebar becomes a scroll-locked, focus-trapped drawer.

items.name: integration-grid
items.title: Integration Grid
items.description: A four-state integrations directory: debounced search and category facets that really filter, a live result count, and per-card connect / disconnect with pending, error and retry.

items.name: metric-overview
items.title: Metric Overview
items.description: A dashboard KPI row — one shared range switcher over comparable cards, deltas coloured by each metric's polarity, and a sparkline per card.

items.name: error-page
items.title: Error Page
items.description: A full-viewport error page for 404 / 403 / 500 / offline / maintenance — per-type copy and advice, a back button that degrades when the history stack is empty, live online status, and a copyable error ID behind collapsed diagnostics.

items.name: roadmap-board
items.title: Roadmap Board
items.description: A public product roadmap in planned / in-progress / shipped lanes, with optimistic upvoting that rolls back and reports the failure, per-lane empty states and real loading/empty/error branches.

items.name: job-listings
items.title: Job Listings
items.description: A four-state careers board: roles grouped by department, three filters that really combine (department, location, remote-only), a live result count, and salary ranges whose absence is spelled out instead of left blank.

items.name: git-graph
items.title: Git Graph
items.description: A commit-DAG viewer with reusable swimlanes — topological ordering, lane reuse after merges, orphan roots, shallow-history tails, copyable full hashes and four data states.

items.name: poll-results
items.title: Poll Results
items.description: A poll / survey result readout — one bar per option with largest-remainder percentages that always total exactly 100%, tie-aware leader badges, a your-vote marker, and a ballot view that hides the counts until the visitor votes.

items.name: resource-usage
items.title: Resource Usage
items.description: A quota panel for heterogeneous resources — per-unit formatting (1024-based bytes, throughput, duration, cores, counts, money), unlimited rows with no bar at all, rescaled over-quota tracks, collapsible groups and usage sorting.

items.name: metric-comparison
items.title: Metric Comparison
items.description: A period-over-period comparison table — current, previous, absolute change and change %, with polarity-aware tone, sortable columns, expandable breakdowns and four data states.

items.name: token-usage-meter
items.title: Token Usage Meter
items.description: An LLM quota panel — tokens used vs quota, split by model with separate input/output prices, an exact cost estimate, days to reset and a burn-rate projection, in four contract-driven states.

items.name: tool-call-trace
items.title: Tool Call Trace
items.description: An agent's tool-call tree — nested sub-calls with a capped indent, structured args and results in expandable JSON, one shared duration unit, first-class running/failed calls, and real loading/empty/error states.

items.name: event-card
items.title: Event Card
items.description: An event card whose calendar tear-off survives cross-day, cross-month and cross-year spans, formats every instant in an explicit IANA zone, and drives an ordered capacity machine where ended outranks the seat count.

items.name: keyboard-map
items.title: Keyboard Map
items.description: A keyboard layout diagram with your app's shortcuts painted onto the caps — platform-correct glyphs and modifier order (⌘ ⌥ vs Ctrl Alt), whole-chord highlighting, and a readable binding list.

items.name: csv-import
items.title: CSV Import
items.description: A three-step CSV importer — RFC 4180 parsing (quoted delimiters, embedded newlines, doubled quotes), delimiter and BOM detection, auto-guessed column mapping with duplicate and required-field gates, and a capped preview that reports ragged rows by line number.

items.name: recurrence-picker
items.title: Recurrence Picker
items.description: A calendar-language repeat editor that writes an RFC 5545 RRULE — frequency, interval, weekday chips, "second Tuesday" / "last day of the month", and a Never / N times / until-date ending — with the next dates previewed from the same rule evaluator.

items.name: seat-picker
items.title: Seat Picker
items.description: A zoomable SVG venue map for picking seats — section/row/seat keyboard navigation, per-seat spoken names, shape+pattern status encoding, a list fallback, max-seat and no-orphan rules.

items.name: variant-selector
items.title: Variant Selector
items.description: Multi-dimension product options resolved against a sparse SKU matrix — impossible combinations stay visible and struck through, availability converges from either direction, and dead ends name the one dimension to change.

items.name: model-selector
items.title: Model Selector
items.description: An LLM model picker whose options carry context window, per-million input/output rates, capability badges and real availability — and can be filtered and sorted by them.

items.name: pdf-viewer
items.title: PDF Viewer
items.description: A document viewer shell with a pluggable render layer — controlled paging synced to scroll, fit-width/fit-page zoom that re-fits on resize, thumbnail rail, text search, keyboard and pinch, named loading/404/damaged/encrypted states, and a native <object> fallback.

items.name: video-timeline
items.title: Video Timeline
items.description: A controlled scrub track with chapter-segmented rail, buffered ranges, keyframe hover previews and draggable in/out trim handles — delta dragging, frame-accurate keys, no player attached.

items.name: qr-scanner
items.title: QR Scanner
items.description: A camera QR reader on the native BarcodeDetector with a pluggable decoder — an enforced scan frame, a throttled decode loop, a per-value cooldown, an image fallback, and a camera that is always released.

items.name: pagination-cursor
items.title: Cursor Pagination
items.description: A load-more control for cursor APIs — a synchronous in-flight guard so one cursor is never fetched twice, an optional intersection sentinel with a burst budget, retry that keeps the loaded rows, and a live-region count.

items.name: tab-overflow
items.title: Tab Overflow
items.description: A measured tab strip that folds the tabs it cannot fit into a "More" menu — real tablist semantics, the selected tab is never collapsed, and no breakpoints anywhere.

items.name: rate-limit-notice
items.title: Rate Limit Notice
items.description: A 429 panel whose cooldown recomputes from an absolute target instant, so a suspended tab wakes up to the right number — auto-unlock with milestone-only announcements and no auto-retry, remaining quota with icon/word/outline urgency, consecutive-backoff labelling and an upgrade CTA.

items.name: conflict-resolver
items.title: Conflict Resolver
items.description: A field-level three-way merge for concurrent edits — base/mine/theirs per field, only the genuinely conflicting fields asked about as radiogroups, bulk fill with per-field override, and a merged record on submit.

items.name: settings-page
items.title: Settings Page
items.description: A settings page shell — section nav, per-section save, and an unsaved-changes guard that stops a section switch with save / discard / cancel instead of dropping the edit.

items.name: api-keys-panel
items.title: API Keys Panel
items.description: A four-state API key manager built around show-the-secret-once — a forced acknowledgement before the reveal can be closed, a name-repeating revoke confirmation, and lifecycle plus never-used called out per key.

items.name: chart-sankey
items.title: Sankey Diagram
items.description: A four-state Sankey diagram that checks the books before it draws: flow conservation per node, cycle detection, longest-path layering, cross-layer ribbons and a minimum ribbon width, with an sr-only flow table.

items.name: chart-cohort-retention
items.title: Cohort Retention Grid
items.description: A triangular cohort-retention table — one row per entry cohort, one column per period since signup, cells that carry both a colour-graded rate and its absolute count, with unobserved periods left blank instead of zeroed.

items.name: chart-heatmap-matrix
items.title: Heatmap Matrix
items.description: A rows × columns value grid with sequential and diverging colour scales — the diverging arms stay symmetric around the centre, the domain is fixable so two grids stay comparable, and missing values never render as zero.

items.name: chart-bar-grouped
items.title: Grouped Bar Chart
items.description: A four-state grouped bar chart that flips to horizontal rows when columns would go under 10px, textures every series so colour is never the only cue, and keeps missing readings distinct from measured zeros.

items.name: use-optimistic
items.title: useOptimistic
items.description: Keyed optimistic updates for plain props and event handlers: props always reclaim a stale overlay so counters cannot drift, sync throws become rejections, repeat clicks on a pending key are refused, out-of-order resolves lose, and failures roll back with a readable error.

items.name: use-event-source
items.title: useEventSource
items.description: Subscribe to a Server-Sent Events stream with a four-state connection machine, capped exponential-backoff reconnects, named-event subscriptions and callbacks that never re-open the stream.

items.name: use-query-param
items.title: useQueryParam
items.description: An SSR-safe hook that keeps a piece of state in a URL query parameter, with typed codecs, defaults kept out of the link, replace-by-default history and every instance on the page in sync.

items.name: use-indexed-db
items.title: useIndexedDb
items.description: An async IndexedDB-backed store hook: loading state, versioned upgrades, blocked-deadlock handling, quota errors, key-range queries and cross-tab invalidation.

items.name: scrollbar-styles
items.title: Scrollbar Styles
items.description: Six presets that re-skin the browser's own scrollbar in pure CSS — no JavaScript, no drawn thumb, and one capability-tiered sheet that keeps `::-webkit-scrollbar` and `scrollbar-width` from cancelling each other out.

items.name: chart-pareto
items.title: Pareto Chart
items.description: A four-state Pareto chart: bars ranked high to low with a cumulative-percentage curve on a second axis, a configurable 80% line, and the crossing bar named.

items.name: chart-boxplot
items.title: Box Plot
items.description: A four-state box plot comparing distributions side by side: R-7 quartiles, Tukey 1.5×IQR whiskers on real observations, de-overlapped outliers, and raw points for groups too small for quartiles.

items.name: chart-bump
items.title: Bump Chart
items.description: A four-state bump chart: one line per entity on a reversed integer position scale, competition ranking for ties, edge labels at both ends, and a broken line wherever an entity is off the board.

items.name: chart-slope
items.title: Slope Chart
items.description: A four-state slope chart for two points in time: labels at both ends, a pooling avoidance pass that never moves the points, leader lines back to the real endpoint, and a same-unit refusal.

items.name: billing-history
items.title: Billing History
items.description: A four-state invoice list — per-currency money through Intl, a six-state lifecycle with partial-refund arithmetic, real filters and pagination, and PDF links that never render as dead buttons.

items.name: notification-preferences
items.title: Notification Preferences
items.description: An events × channels notification matrix that saves as you toggle: per-switch pending and single-switch rollback on failure, locked always-on rows, a disconnected channel column with a real Connect entry point, row/column bulk actions with a bulk-vs-manual marker, and a quiet-hours window that wraps past midnight.

items.name: two-factor-setup
items.title: Two-Factor Setup
items.description: The enable-2FA flow around its one irreversible step — QR plus a copyable manual key, a six-digit check whose attempt budget only ever goes down, and recovery codes rendered once behind a finish button that refuses to fire until they are saved.

items.name: usage-dashboard
items.title: Usage Dashboard
items.description: A period-scoped usage block — headline, quota bar, cumulative burn-up curve and per-dimension breakdown all derived from one bucket array, so the four readouts cannot disagree; run-rate projection stated apart from actual usage, and period switches that never put a new label over old figures.

items.name: empty-dashboard
items.title: Empty Dashboard
items.description: A first-run dashboard: welcome copy, a setup checklist whose progress counts done separately from skipped, a labelled skeleton of the filled dashboard, and a confirmed sample-data escape hatch — the block renders nothing once nothing is left to do.

items.name: search-results
items.title: Search Results
items.description: A four-state search results page — query echo, keyword highlighting, faceted type/recency/tag filters whose counts are the real post-click result count, and pagination that snaps back to page 1 on every filter change.

items.name: checkout-form
items.title: Checkout Form
items.description: A one-page checkout — contact, delivery address, payment method and an order summary whose delivery, tax and payment fee are derived from the form in the same render, in integer minor units, so the lines always add up to the button and the money can never lag the address.

items.name: order-confirmation
items.title: Order Confirmation
items.description: A post-checkout receipt block — a dictatable, one-click-copyable order number, an itemised table whose money is refined to add up, a delivery window rather than a promised day, ship / pickup / digital fulfillment, and print styles that keep it on paper.

items.name: feature-comparison
items.title: Feature Comparison
items.description: A dated us-vs-competitors capability table — yes / partial / no / not-disclosed told apart by shape and word, numeric rows with a per-row unit, a frozen capability column, and a verified-on date measured against an injected now.

items.name: case-study-grid
items.title: Case Study Grid
items.description: A four-state customer-story grid where the quantified result is the first-class field: every metric carries value, unit, direction and a required baseline (or says "No baseline captured"), industry and company-size facets really filter with truthful counts, and logos of any aspect ratio are optically area-matched.

items.name: feature-flag-list
items.title: Feature Flag List
items.description: A per-environment feature flag table — production toggles gated behind a confirmation that repeats the flag key, rollout percentage kept orthogonal to on/off, optimistic switches that roll back one at a time, expandable targeting rules, and real loading/empty/error states.

items.name: webhook-log
items.title: Webhook Log
items.description: A webhook delivery log with the retry lifecycle built in — outcome classes that keep timeouts separate from status codes, a countdown to the next attempt derived from an injected clock, masked credential headers, collapsed payloads with honest truncation, and a guarded replay confirmation.

items.name: citation-list
items.title: Citation List
items.description: The numbered reference list under an AI answer — numbering derived the same way Citation Chip derives it so the markers and the list always agree, repeated sources merged with a citation count, graded trust that never relies on colour, and sources with no usable URL that refuse to become dead links.

items.name: dependency-list
items.title: Dependency List
items.description: An auditable dependency tree — real semver comparison, graded staleness, ordered CVE severities, licence obligation classes, and the import chain behind every transitive package.

items.name: sla-report
items.title: SLA Report
items.description: A contract-side availability settlement — real period length, overlap-merged downtime, weighted or worst-service composite, an error budget that is allowed to read past 100%, and the service-credit rung the period landed on.

items.name: screen-recorder
items.title: Screen Recorder
items.description: A real getDisplayMedia screen recorder — surface picker, optional microphone mixdown, live duration and size, and a preview you can download.

items.name: audio-transcript
items.title: Audio Transcript
items.description: A timestamped, speaker-labelled transcript synced to a playhead — the spoken line highlights and stays in view until the reader scrolls away, any line seeks to its exact start, and search steps through every hit.

items.name: fit-text
items.title: Fit Text
items.description: One line of text scaled until it exactly fills the width it was given — headline, KPI number or cover title, sized from a real browser measurement instead of an estimate.

items.name: balanced-heading
items.title: Balanced Heading
items.description: A heading that breaks its lines to even lengths instead of stranding one word on the last line — pure CSS text-wrap with a copy-safe fallback for engines that lack it.

items.name: pull-quote
items.title: Pull Quote
items.description: Editorial pull quote for body copy: centered, floated left/right with the text wrapping around it, or bled past the measure — figure + blockquote + figcaption, with a decorative quote mark that never lands in the clipboard.

items.name: link-underline
items.title: Link Underline
items.description: Underline motion for inline body links — slide, center, wipe or thicken — drawn per line box so wrapped links keep a rule on every line, with descender clearance, a focus ring hover never draws, and text-decoration fallbacks for reduced motion, forced colors and print.

items.name: install-pwa-button
items.title: Install PWA Button
items.description: An install CTA that catches beforeinstallprompt at module scope so a late-mounting button still gets it, and renders nothing at all when the app is installed, was refused recently, or cannot be installed here.

items.name: record-button
items.title: Record Button
items.description: A record control with an idle → recording → processing → done state machine — drift-free elapsed timer, minimum/maximum take guards, and an optional hold-to-record gesture with slide-away cancel.

items.name: voronoi-cells
items.title: Voronoi Cells
items.description: A slowly flowing Voronoi diagram on one canvas — organic cell walls, a tinted mosaic or separated pebbles, seeded so the same field comes back every time.

items.name: bokeh-lights
items.title: Bokeh Lights
items.description: Slowly floating out-of-focus light discs on one canvas — seeded for a reproducible picture, painted from a pre-rendered sprite instead of a per-frame blur, with an opacity lever that keeps overlaid copy readable.

items.name: scanlines
items.title: Scanlines
items.description: A CRT line grille whose pitch is snapped to the display's physical pixel grid, with an optional one-pixel-per-step roll and a WCAG-clamped flicker.

items.name: chat-sidebar
items.title: Chat Sidebar
items.description: A conversation-history sidebar — calendar-day groups cut in the display time zone, in-place rename with rollback, delete confirmed by title, pinning, local search with its own no-match state, and real loading/empty/error branches.

items.name: chat-window
items.title: Chat Window
items.description: A chat shell in three presentations — inline, docked and modal — with a focus trap, refcounted scroll lock and a resizable dock, that never re-creates the panel when you switch.

items.name: streaming-text
items.title: Streaming Text
items.description: An incremental Markdown renderer for LLM output — finished blocks are frozen, half-written markup is closed speculatively, the caret rides the last character and screen readers hear the answer once.

items.name: message-list
items.title: Message List
items.description: An AI transcript whose scroll behaves — glued to the newest token while streaming, released the instant the reader scrolls up, anchored when older pages land, and windowed so a 1000-turn thread stays a dozen nodes wide.

items.name: chat-composer
items.title: Chat Composer
items.description: A managed chat composer: one send⇄stop button slot, optimistic draft clear with restore-on-failure, AbortSignal handoff, IME-safe Enter and attachments with their own upload lifecycle.

items.name: message-actions
items.title: Message Actions
items.description: The action bar under one chat message — revealed by hover, focus and touch alike (never hover alone), costing zero layout, with copy in either Markdown or plain text, an exclusive thumbs tri-state, a streaming-safe Regenerate and speech that stops when the message unmounts.

items.name: reasoning-block
items.title: Reasoning Block
items.description: A collapsible model-reasoning panel driven by the stream's lifecycle — auto-opens while tokens arrive, auto-collapses when they stop, and permanently stands down once the reader touches it.

items.name: tool-call-card
items.title: Tool Call Card
items.description: One agent tool call inline in a conversation — a first-class approval gate with a one-shot Approve/Decline, structured args and results, key-based redaction that keeps secrets out of the DOM, announced truncation for huge payloads, and real loading/empty/error states.

items.name: citation-chip
items.title: Citation Chip
items.description: The inline [n] marker that trails a sentence in an AI answer — an inline box that cannot change the paragraph's line height, with a source card portalled past every clipping bubble.

items.name: suggested-prompts
items.title: Suggested Prompts
items.description: Click-to-send conversation starters and follow-ups — a wrapping strip of one-shot cards that latches after the first pick, goes inert while the assistant streams, and re-rolls without collapsing the row.

items.name: artifact-panel
items.title: Artifact Panel
items.description: A side panel for the file the assistant keeps rewriting — a revision rail with the prompt behind each one, preview / source / changes, per-revision scroll memory, and copy plus download that always take the revision you are looking at.

items.name: agent-steps
items.title: Agent Steps
items.description: A live agent run whose plan is still being written — steps stream in without moving what is already on screen, failures retry in place, and a replan cancels the rest of the plan instead of failing it.

items.name: context-attachments
items.title: Context Attachments
items.description: The context list attached to a conversation — files, links, snippets and selections with their token cost, under a budget meter that spells out reserve + attachments = used and names exactly which entries get dropped when the window overflows.

items.name: prompt-library
items.title: Prompt Library
items.description: A saved-prompt library with fill-in-the-blank templates — search across title, body and tags, faceted categories, a variable form ordered by first appearance, and a preview that is character-for-character what gets inserted.

items.name: message-branch
items.title: Message Branch
items.description: A compact pager for the sibling variants of one reply — an id-stable selection that survives late arrivals, follow-the-tip on regenerate, ends that never steal focus, and one announcement per move.

items.name: chat-day-divider
items.title: Chat Day Divider
items.description: A muted separator for chat transcripts — day chip, unread watermark and context event — that derives Today/Yesterday from calendar days, relabels itself at local midnight, and can pin to the top while its day scrolls.

items.name: message-skeleton
items.title: Message Skeleton
items.description: A chat-shaped loading placeholder — seeded conversation rhythm, alternating bubbles or document rows, a sweep phase-shifted through the thread, and one late screen-reader announcement.

items.name: streaming-markdown
items.title: Streaming Markdown
items.description: A progressive Markdown renderer for LLM streams that paints only what can no longer change — the ambiguous tail waits in a buffer instead of flashing raw markup.

items.name: streaming-table
items.title: Streaming Table
items.description: A table that renders while its rows are still arriving — the header locks the column geometry on frame one, cells still in flight shimmer in place, and the footer count settles into a total.

items.name: streaming-code
items.title: Streaming Code
items.description: A code panel that renders while the model is still writing it — caret on the last line, frozen finished lines, regex tinting, copy-what-arrived and auto-scroll the reader can break.

items.name: model-compare
items.title: Model Compare
items.description: A side-by-side arena for two answers to one prompt — per-side streaming states, derived speed, optional blind names, and a vote that fires exactly once.

items.name: pinned-messages
items.title: Pinned Messages
items.description: A pinned-messages strip for a conversation — one chip per pin, as many as genuinely fit measured against the real container, the rest collapsed into a +N more panel, unpin behind a confirmation that fires once, and real loading/empty/error states.

items.name: message-search
items.title: Message Search
items.description: In-conversation search that expands from an icon into a field — debounced dispatch, a hit counter walked with Enter and Shift+Enter, and a result list of role, time and an excerpt with the query emphasised.

items.name: edit-message
items.title: Edit Message
items.description: In-place editor for a message that was already sent — it states how many replies the fork will drop, guards the draft on cancel, keeps it on a rejected resubmit, and never forks for unchanged text.

items.name: quote-reply
items.title: Quote Reply
items.description: Quote-and-reply for a transcript — a floating Quote action over a text selection, a dismissible quote chip above the composer, and a whole-message fallback.

items.name: conversation-summary
items.title: Conversation Summary
items.description: A compaction seam for long chats — a hairline marker that reports how many earlier messages were summarized, discloses the bullet summary, and offers a restore that can only fire once.

items.name: scroll-to-latest
items.title: Scroll To Latest
items.description: A floating jump-to-latest pill for a growing chat viewport — a sentinel decides when the reader has left the floor, arrivals since then ride in the badge, and one click re-pins follow mode.

items.name: read-aloud-button
items.title: Read Aloud Button
items.description: A per-message listen toggle — progress ring, tiny equalizer and a speed pill — driven by the browser's speech engine or by your own TTS callbacks.

items.name: translation-toggle
items.title: Translation Toggle
items.description: A per-message translation affordance — a pill that names the detected source language, crossfades between original and translation while the box tweens between their measured heights, re-aims at another target language from a menu, and stands in with a skeleton shaped by the source while a request is in flight.

items.name: ai-disclaimer
items.title: AI Disclaimer
items.description: The 'AI can make mistakes. Check important info.' line — inline, banner and details-popover chromes, role=note so it never interrupts, and a one-shot dismissal that hands persistence to the app.

items.name: ai-badge
items.title: AI Badge
items.description: A provenance chip for AI-touched content — generated / assisted / human-edited, with the model and timestamp behind a tooltip or popover and a contrast-safe overlay mode for images.

items.name: stop-generating
items.title: Stop Generating
items.description: One button slot for the whole run — Stop while tokens arrive, Continue generating when the reply hit its length cap, nothing when idle, with a scoped Esc binding and a one-shot lock on both actions.

items.name: regenerate-menu
items.title: Regenerate Menu
items.description: A split retry control for one assistant answer — the button half re-runs it, the chevron opens a menu with a model submenu that marks the current model and an inline instruction field, and every path emits one discriminated action.

items.name: response-feedback
items.title: Response Feedback
items.description: Thumbs up or down on one AI answer, with a follow-up panel of reason chips and a comment, and exactly one submission per message — locked into a receipt when it lands.

items.name: share-conversation
items.title: Share Conversation
items.description: A publish-a-link share dialog for a chat thread — server-issued URL, optimistic visibility and attachment writes with rollback, copy feedback and a destructive revoke confirm.

items.name: conversation-export
items.title: Conversation Export
items.description: An export menu for a whole conversation — scope radio, a size estimate on every format, and a row that spins, ticks or turns into Retry without the menu ever closing under it.

items.name: answer-sources
items.title: Answer Sources
items.description: The numbered favicon cards behind one AI answer — a scrolling strip or an expandable list, the retrieved excerpt one hover or one Tab away, dead sources that refuse to link, and four data states.

items.name: confidence-meter
items.title: Confidence Meter
items.description: A response-confidence reading — segmented bar or small ring banded by your own cut points, with a 'why' disclosure that breaks the score into per-signal factor rows.

items.name: moderation-notice
items.title: Moderation Notice
items.description: Content-policy interruption states for chat — blocked input, withheld response and softened answer, with category chips that cross-highlight the flagged passage, a one-shot appeal action, and role=alert only when something was actually stopped.

items.name: slash-command-menu
items.title: Slash Command Menu
items.description: A caret-anchored "/" command popup for a textarea you already own — sectioned list, roving keyboard cursor, and one commit that either inserts a token or fires an action.

items.name: dictation-button
items.title: Dictation Button
items.description: A composer mic that turns speech into committed text — toggle or hold-to-talk, an amplitude ring, a live interim chip, and exactly one transcript per session.

items.name: prompt-variables
items.title: Prompt Variables
items.description: An inline template filler — every {{variable}} slot becomes a chip-sized text, select or number editor inside the sentence, repeats mirror the first one live, and the preview is byte-identical to what gets sent.

items.name: prompt-enhancer
items.title: Prompt Enhancer
items.description: An "improve my prompt" affordance for a prompt field — a shimmering request state, a word-level diff of the rewrite, and a one-shot Accept with undo.

items.name: persona-picker
items.title: Persona Picker
items.description: Choose the assistant persona a turn runs under — seeded avatar cards or a compact combobox, capability tags, the system-prompt fragment each persona quietly injects, unavailable rows that say why, and four data states.

items.name: tone-selector
items.title: Tone Selector
items.description: A radio-group row of rewrite tones where every pill carries a sample phrase, and the custom tone applies only once its free-text instruction is committed.

items.name: sampling-controls
items.title: Sampling Controls
items.description: A controlled panel for temperature, top-p, max tokens and the penalties — editable value badges, a worded creative-to-precise scale, per-parameter revert, and a nudge when temperature and top-p are tuned together.

items.name: system-prompt-editor
items.title: System Prompt Editor
items.description: A system-prompt editing surface: an autosizing monospace field with placeholder highlighting painted behind the caret, a live token estimate against a budget, presets that insert without destroying work, and an unsaved bar that owns Save and Discard.

items.name: chat-mode-picker
items.title: Chat Mode Picker
items.description: The composer's capability chips — web search, deep research, canvas, image — with a plan gate, a context gate, a cap, conflicting pairs, and a set that repairs itself when the model changes.

items.name: context-limit-banner
items.title: Context Limit Banner
items.description: A context-window warning that escalates from a quiet notice to a blocking wall — a thin usage meter with threshold ticks, rising-edge-only announcements, dismissal that re-arms on escalation, and the three exits out of a full conversation.

items.name: agent-inbox
items.title: Agent Inbox
items.description: A human-in-the-loop queue of everything your agents parked on a person — triage ranking, overdue flags, one-shot inline Approve/Deny, grouping by agent or urgency, and four data states.

items.name: agent-plan
items.title: Agent Plan
items.description: An agent's plan while it is still a draft — ordered steps with their rationale, risk chips on the dangerous ones, per-step include/exclude, inline rewriting, a live duration and cost estimate for the steps you kept, and a one-shot Approve or Request changes.

items.name: task-queue
items.title: Task Queue
items.description: An agent work queue — live progress and the current step for running tasks, drag-to-reprioritise queued ones with a keyboard path, one-shot cancel and retry per row, a concurrency budget in the header, and four data states.

items.name: agent-status
items.title: Agent Status
items.description: A compact agent state chip — a dot and a label morphing through idle, thinking, tool use, waiting-on-you and failure, with a drift-free phase clock and one polite announcement per phase.

items.name: run-summary
items.title: Run Summary
items.description: The receipt for one finished agent run — outcome and reason, a duration/token/cost stat strip, and an expandable per-model table that says so when its rows don't add up to the headline totals.

items.name: chat-checkpoint
items.title: Chat Checkpoint
items.description: A conversation save point that guards its own restore — named marker, live age, auto vs manual origin, an "N messages since" cost line, and a one-shot rollback that explains the fork before it happens.

items.name: computer-use-panel
items.title: Computer Use Panel
items.description: A computer-use session viewer — screenshots with the agent's click, type, scroll and drag markers drawn on them, a synced action log you step through with the arrow keys, and live follow-and-takeover.

items.name: web-preview
items.title: Web Preview
items.description: A browser pane an agent drives — read-only address bar, a history scrubber that follows the newest page until you step back, a load bar, fit-to-pane width presets and a console drawer.

items.name: mcp-server-list
items.title: MCP Server List
items.description: A four-state MCP connections manager — transport and live status per server, an enable switch that is intent while status stays reality, cached tool chips with an honest count, and per-row reconnect or authorize.

items.name: tool-catalog
items.title: Tool Catalog
items.description: A searchable registry of the tools an agent may call — source facets with live counts, per-tool allow switches, parameter tables that open themselves when the query lands inside a signature, and four data states.

items.name: agent-handoff
items.title: Agent Handoff
items.description: An agent-to-agent handoff marker — from/to avatars, a track that marches while the transfer is in flight, the reason control moved, chips for the context passed along, and who holds the run; compact divider and detailed card variants.

items.name: agent-roster
items.title: Agent Roster
items.description: A multi-agent fleet panel — per-agent state dot, model chip, current-task line and capacity bar, attention-first sorting, a real listbox keyboard path, and four data states.

items.name: agent-graph
items.title: Agent Graph
items.description: A workflow DAG drawn in pure SVG from nodes and edges alone — layered auto-layout with crossing reduction, typed node shapes, status tints, flowing active wires, loop-back routing and four data states.

items.name: inline-completion
items.title: Inline Completion
items.description: Ghost text for a textarea — a caret-aligned mirror paints the model's continuation in muted type, Tab accepts it, Cmd/Ctrl+Right takes one word, Esc dismisses.

items.name: file-change-list
items.title: File Change List
items.description: The files an agent touched — middle-truncated paths, A/M/D/R marks, churn bars scaled across the whole run, one-shot Accept/Revert per file plus a bulk bar, and a slot for the inline diff.

items.name: interpreter-output
items.title: Interpreter Output
items.description: The result of one code-interpreter run — source collapsed by default, stdout / stderr / rich results behind tabs derived from what actually arrived, the exception pinned above them, tail-capped output that sticks while it streams, and a one-shot Re-run.

items.name: human-handoff
items.title: Human Handoff
items.description: A bot-to-human escalation card that walks one ticket through request, queue, connecting, connected and an offline leave-your-address fallback.

items.name: scheduled-tasks
items.title: Scheduled Tasks
items.description: A list of scheduled agent automations — a human cadence next to a live countdown to the next run, the last run's outcome inline, a pause switch, a one-shot manual trigger, the failure printed on the row that broke, and four data states.

items.name: retrieval-results
items.title: Retrieval Results
items.description: The RAG retrieval step opened up — ranked chunk cards with source and page, a similarity bar carrying the pipeline cutoff, whole-word query emphasis, a used-in-answer badge wired to its citation number, and a threshold divider that refuses to lie.

items.name: knowledge-picker
items.title: Knowledge Picker
items.description: A grounding-scope selector for collections, files and links — tri-state collections that cascade only over what is actually selectable, per-source document and chunk counts with index freshness, an accounting bar that prices the selection in chunks, and four data states.

items.name: indexing-progress
items.title: Indexing Progress
items.description: An ingest pipeline board — per-source parse → chunk → embed chips, a byte-weighted aggregate with a derived ETA, failures that keep the stage they died at behind a one-shot retry, and a completed summary.

items.name: web-search-card
items.title: Web Search Card
items.description: One web-search step inline in a conversation — the queries the model typed, the pages that came back, which ones it actually read and which ended up cited, with a data-driven reading shimmer and four data states.

items.name: voice-orb
items.title: Voice Orb
items.description: A voice-session orb — layered token gradients that breathe when idle, ripple to a 0..1 amplitude while listening, swirl while thinking and pulse while speaking.

items.name: voice-chat
items.title: Voice Chat
items.description: A realtime voice session panel — speaking orb, word-by-word live captions, mute, mic picker, connection meter, session clock, and an end-of-call summary.

items.name: live-captions
items.title: Live Captions
items.description: A broadcast-style caption bar for a live recogniser feed — interim words render muted and solidify when finalised, a rolling two-line window follows the speech, speaker chips carry the turn, and the panel hides itself after silence.

items.name: voice-picker
items.title: Voice Picker
items.description: Pick the TTS voice a reply is spoken in — cards or a combobox, language and accent chips, neutral timbre tags, and a play button that auditions without selecting, with exactly one sample sounding at a time.

items.name: model-card
items.title: Model Card
items.description: One model's spec sheet — context window, max output and cutoff, tri-state capability chips, per-million-token pricing with the cached-read discount, benchmark bars that switch to a signed comparison against a baseline, and a deprecation notice that names the successor.

items.name: cost-breakdown
items.title: Cost Breakdown
items.description: An LLM cost receipt — every metered line as quantity × rate = amount in micro-unit money that keeps sub-cent charges, grouping by model or kind, a highlighted prompt-caching savings line, and four contract-driven states.

items.name: eval-scorecard
items.title: Eval Scorecard
items.description: One evaluation run at a glance — an overall dial marked with the pass gate, per-criterion bars carrying their own gate ticks and baseline deltas, regressions called out by name, and the worst failing cases disclosed on the row that owns them.

items.name: logprobs-viewer
items.title: Logprobs Viewer
items.description: Token-level probabilities for a model response — the answer itself heat-tinted by uncertainty on one chart token, dotted-underlined below a live threshold, with top-k alternatives as probability bars on hover, focus or arrow key.

items.name: finetune-status
items.title: Finetune Status
items.description: One fine-tune run as a card — a pipeline strip that keeps the stage a stopped run died at, derived step/epoch progress, a scrubbable train/validation loss sparkline with broken eval gaps, hyperparameter rows, a checkpoint radiogroup that re-targets the deploy action, and a one-shot cancel behind an inline destructive confirm.

items.name: batch-jobs
items.title: Batch Jobs
items.description: A batch inference jobs table — middle-truncated copyable job ids, a stacked done/failed/pending bar per job, spend so far, age and ETA derived from an injected clock, an expandable failed-request preview, a one-shot cancel, partial-result downloads, and four data states.

items.name: safety-controls
items.title: Safety Controls
items.description: Per-category content thresholds on a four-rung scale — a plain-language line for what each rung actually does, strictness presets that batch-set every row, policy floors and locked rows, and an unsaved-changes bar that names the filters you are about to loosen.

items.name: memory-list
items.title: Memory List
items.description: The things an assistant remembers about someone, as a list they can audit — inline editing behind a one-editor lock, a two-step bin that fires exactly once, an add box that refuses duplicates, per-memory and master switches, the "used in this chat" highlight, and four data states.

items.name: custom-instructions
items.title: Custom Instructions
items.description: An end-user preference form for assistant instructions: autosizing questions with example popovers, per-field character budgets, one switch that gates every field without erasing it, and a Save / Cancel bar whose Cancel stays undoable.

items.name: model-router
items.title: Model Router
