items.description: A routing policy panel — ordered first-match-wins rules with testable condition chips, per-rule switches with optimistic rollback, a health-aware fallback chain, and a prompt tester that names the rule which claims a request and the ones never asked.

items.name: cache-indicator
items.title: Cache Indicator
items.description: A prompt-cache chip for one request — hit / partial / miss / write derived from the token counts, a tooltip breakdown of cached vs fresh tokens and money saved, and a self-correcting TTL ring that flips the chip to expired and fires onExpire exactly once.

items.name: tokenizer-preview
items.title: Tokenizer Preview
items.description: A tokenizer playground for input text — alternating-tinted token chunks from a deterministic built-in splitter or your own, token/char/word counts, a live cost estimate at an editable per-Mtok rate, and markers for whitespace and unusually long tokens.

items.name: few-shot-editor
items.title: Few Shot Editor
items.description: A few-shot example manager — paired input/output cards you add, duplicate, drag-reorder and switch off, with per-example and total token estimates against a budget, and gentle hints for blank outputs and near-duplicate inputs.

items.name: embedding-map
items.title: Embedding Map
items.description: A 2-D embedding scatter in pure SVG — clusters carried by chart token and mark shape, centroid names that yield instead of overlapping, a query wired to the retriever's own ranking, and four data states.

items.name: structured-output
items.title: Structured Output
items.description: A JSON-mode response rendered through its schema — labelled rows in schema order, kind-aware values, field-level expected-vs-got validation, pending fields while the stream runs, off-schema keys kept, and a raw JSON view.

items.name: pii-detector
items.title: PII Detector
items.description: A pre-send privacy scan — detected emails, phones, cards, IDs and names underlined by category, a hover or focus popover per entity, a mask-or-keep decision on each, and a masked preview of exactly what will be sent.

items.name: thinking-indicator
items.title: Thinking Indicator
items.description: A transcript-line thinking status — a highlight sweeping the label, a phase walk that never lies about progress, a clock that only appears once the wait is real, and a fade-out that hands the slot to the answer.

items.name: queue-position
items.title: Queue Position
items.description: A generation-queue waiting room — a position dial that rolls down through every place it passes, a drain bar measured from where you joined, a self-correcting ETA, an optimistic notify-me switch and an arm-before-you-lose-it leave action.

items.name: conversation-title
items.title: Conversation Title
items.description: An auto-generated chat title — a sparkle provenance hint, click-to-edit rename with a length counter, and a regenerate button that shimmer-cycles candidate names before settling.

items.name: ai-selection-menu
items.title: AI Selection Menu
items.description: An Ask-AI row that floats over a text selection — action shortcuts, submenus, a free-form question field, one captured excerpt and a keyboard path in.

items.name: rewrite-preview
items.title: Rewrite Preview
items.description: A prose rewrite review panel — sentence-level tints, per-paragraph Accept / Keep verdicts, measured delta chips and a one-shot Apply that hands back the merged draft.

items.name: assistant-avatar
items.title: Assistant Avatar
items.description: An assistant identity chip whose ring carries the state — a portrait or a seed-derived token gradient inside, ripples while listening, a conic sweep while thinking, equalizer ticks while speaking.

items.name: image-generation
items.title: Image Generation
items.description: An image-generation result card — the prompt above a variations grid that blurs up and scans while it renders, per-image download / upscale / vary, a first-class safety-blocked state, and the seed behind whichever variation you pick.

items.name: video-generation
items.title: Video Generation
items.description: A text-to-video render as one card — prompt, a storyboard that fills in frame by frame, a staged bar that cannot rewind, a poster with a duration chip when it lands, and a failure that keeps the frames it managed to make.

items.name: chatbot-widget
items.title: Chatbot Widget
items.description: An embeddable support chat widget — launcher bubble with an acknowledged unread badge, a panel that keeps its draft when minimised, quick replies, and a rating row on the way out.

items.name: ai-answer
items.title: AI Answer
items.description: A search-answer section — the question, the sources it stands on, prose whose every sentence carries a numbered chip back to a source, follow-ups, and a streaming pass where sources land before the text.

items.name: research-report
items.title: Research Report
items.description: The finished output of a deep-research run — prose whose citation numbers are derived from one walk of the data, per-section source chips, an outline that follows the reader, and a methodology footer that shows the queries run and the sources rejected.

items.name: agent-dashboard
items.title: Agent Dashboard
items.description: An agent-ops overview — KPI tiles whose trends are derived, a runs-over-time bar chart, a recent-runs table whose failing rows expand to the error line, and a live-agent rail that filters the table without moving the window figures.

items.name: assistant-welcome
items.title: Assistant Welcome
items.description: A first-run assistant hero — greeting, capability cards and starter chips that prefill the host's composer instead of sending, over a token-only animated accent.

items.name: api-error-card
items.title: API Error Card
items.description: An LLM API failure card whose recovery is chosen by error class — a countdown ring with one-shot opt-in auto-retry for 429s, a key-settings exit for auth, a status-page exit for overload, and trim / summarize exits when the context is too long.

items.name: stream-inspector
items.title: Stream Inspector
items.description: A developer feed of the raw frames of one streamed model response — per-frame offsets and gaps, a TTFT marker line, header stats, stall marking with jump-to-next, delta folding, tail-follow with break-away and a pretty/raw toggle per row.

items.name: prompt-diff
items.title: Prompt Diff
items.description: A word-level diff of two prompt versions — split or unified columns, version chips with author, date and run count, side swap, per-version copy and a one-shot restore.

items.name: throughput-meter
items.title: Throughput Meter
items.description: A live tokens-per-second readout — rolling sparkline, time to first token, current-vs-average delta, a stall flag raised by the meter's own clock, and a run summary when the stream ends.

items.name: context-inspector
items.title: Context Inspector
items.description: A stacked map of the assembled prompt — system, tools, files, memory and history as proportional slices with per-entry token costs, an expandable breakdown that never hides what it didn't itemise, a reply-headroom band that warns before the answer stops fitting, and a what-if preview of every evictable entry.

items.name: guardrail-trace
items.title: Guardrail Trace
items.description: The safety evaluation of one request, rule by rule — a verdict header derived from the rules rather than asserted beside them, matched-span excerpts with per-rule rationale, verdict filter chips, a passing-row budget that can never hide a block, and four data states.

items.name: conversation-tree
items.title: Conversation Tree
items.description: The branching map of a whole chat — a flat parentId list nested into a vertical tree, the current path lit as a continuous spine, abandoned forks folded into counted stubs, WAI-ARIA tree keyboard navigation, and four data states.

items.name: agent-permissions
items.title: Agent Permissions
items.description: A capability-scoping panel for one agent — per-tool switches with risk bands, a spend cap metered against what is already spent, an add-and-remove domain allowlist, an ordered file-access scale with policy ceilings, and an unsaved-changes bar that counts every change that expands the agent's authority.

items.name: latency-breakdown
items.title: Latency Breakdown
items.description: Per-request phase bars — queue, TTFT, generation and tool time on one shared scale, with a floor that keeps sub-pixel phases visible, a legend that ranks the runs by a phase, and a p50/p95 footer that names the population it came from.

items.name: prompt-arena
items.title: Prompt Arena
items.description: Pairwise prompt results as a scoreboard you can act on — an A/tie/B split bar, a verdict gated by a Wilson interval instead of a raw lead, sampled matchups with their own vote splits, the two outputs for one input on demand, and a rerun that fires exactly once.

items.name: dataset-browser
items.title: Dataset Browser
items.description: A prompt/completion dataset row by row — one-line pair previews, quality-flag chips with the rule behind each one, the full pair one click away, OR'd flag filters, and a selection that survives filtering feeding a bulk export/remove bar.

items.name: labeling-queue
items.title: Labeling Queue
items.description: A one-item-at-a-time human labeling queue — number-key label buttons, skip and flag escapes, a resumable "34 / 200" progress bar, undo for the last call, an all-done screen, and a one-shot lock per item so a double press can never double-label.

items.name: detection-overlay
items.title: Detection Overlay
items.description: Object-detection results drawn over the picture they came from — per-class tinted boxes with label and confidence chips, a live confidence gate, a class legend, and a rail whose hover, focus and selection stay in sync with the boxes.

items.name: ocr-viewer
items.title: Ocr Viewer
items.description: A scanned page beside the text read off it, kept in sync both ways — hover or focus a line to light up its source box, click a box to focus its line, with low-confidence words underlined in place.

items.name: upgrade-prompt
items.title: Upgrade Prompt
items.description: An in-feature paywall — usage note, benefit bullets, a two-tier mini compare, an async upgrade CTA and a "remind me tomorrow" snooze that round-trips through the host, as a banner or as an overlay that blurs only its own box.

items.name: usage-alerts
items.title: Usage Alerts
items.description: A budget alert-rule manager — threshold tripwires on a scale that runs past 100%, per-rule channels, a one-shot test send with a real in-flight state, and a fired-alert history waiting to be acknowledged, in four contract-driven states.

items.name: request-history
items.title: Request History
items.description: A playground's run rail — every request with the model and knobs it was sent with, pinned favourites kept above the churn, one click to load a run back into the editor, and a confirmation when that would overwrite your draft.

items.name: open-in-chat
items.title: Open In Chat
items.description: A provider menu that turns the content on the page into a written prompt and hands it to ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor or the clipboard — deeplink when it fits the URL, copy when it does not.

items.name: mcp-install-button
items.title: MCP Install Button
items.description: A one-click MCP install control — one server description, translated per client into a Claude Code command, a Claude Desktop or VS Code config or a Cursor deeplink, with copy feedback, placeholder env keys and a verify-connection check.

items.name: commit-card
items.title: Commit Card
items.description: One agent commit as a card — a Conventional Commits badge parsed out of the raw git message, the files it touched behind an announced cap, an agent and timestamp line, a two-step one-shot revert, and a grouped rail for a whole run.

items.name: sandbox-status
items.title: Sandbox Status
items.description: A sandbox lifecycle card — provisioning through reclaimed, CPU / memory meters, an uptime clock that freezes on teardown, and restart / tear-down behind a confirm and a one-shot lock.

items.name: fallback-notice
items.title: Fallback Notice
items.description: An inline "answered by a backup model" notice — the failed primary and the model that answered as a chip chain, reason-class copy, and a one-shot retry-with-primary button that suppresses itself when a retry cannot help.

items.name: persona-editor
items.title: Persona Editor
items.description: An authoring form for one assistant persona: a seed-derived face with a deterministic shuffle, trait chips that refuse rather than truncate, a tone select, budgeted instructions, a preview bubble recomposed on every keystroke, and a save bar that names which fields moved.

items.name: content-credentials
items.title: Content Credentials
items.description: A C2PA-flavoured provenance panel — a four-rung signature verdict, the signing issuer, the created/edited/exported chain, an expandable raw manifest, and a compact chip that opens the whole thing in a popover.

items.name: rate-limit-meter
items.title: Rate Limit Meter
items.description: A live request-budget meter — a rolling-window gauge, a burst-dot timeline of recent calls, an escalating severity band, an expiry-aware forecast of when the limit lands, and a reset countdown once it does.

items.name: byok-setup
items.title: BYOK Setup
items.description: A bring-your-own-key card — configurable provider slots, a masked field that cleans what you paste and checks the shape per provider, a cancellable live test with latency or a reason, a storage disclaimer that never leaves, and removal behind a confirm.

items.name: data-controls
items.title: Data Controls
items.description: An AI privacy panel where every control saves on its own — a training consent switch with a plain-language consequence line, a retention scale that warns when it deletes nothing, an export job with progress, and a type-to-confirm deletion.

items.name: chat-import
items.title: Chat Import
items.description: A staged importer for assistant exports — reads ChatGPT, Claude and JSON-Lines files, previews the conversations it recovered with per-item checkboxes, and ends on a summary that names every skipped item and why.

items.name: ai-form-assist
items.title: AI Form Assist
items.description: Model-filled form fields — a sparkle per row, ghost-rendered values with a confidence tint, source popovers, a staggered fill-all wave, and per-field accept, dismiss and undo.

items.name: translation-panel
items.title: Translation Panel
items.description: A document beside its machine translation, aligned segment by segment — hover or focus a pair and both halves light up, with per-segment translated / waiting / failed states, a swappable language header, a formality control and progress over the whole job.

items.name: date-picker
items.title: Date Picker
items.description: A typeable single-date field with a calendar panel — Intl-driven formatting and parsing, a complete keyboard grid, and refusals that keep what you typed.

items.name: input-group
items.title: Input Group
items.description: A composable affix shell for one field — static text, icon slots and interactive trailing controls flush inside a single border, with size, invalid and disabled flowing down to every slot.

items.name: icon-picker
items.title: Icon Picker
items.description: A searchable icon grid in a popover — the pickable set is a name → component map you supply, paged into bounded windows, with combobox keyboard navigation and recents.

items.name: button-group
items.title: Button Group
items.description: A welded row or column of independent actions — 1px seams, outer corners only, an unclipped focus ring, and a measured unweld when the row stops fitting.

items.name: toggle-group
items.title: Toggle Group
items.description: A row or column of independent aria-pressed toggles — one tab stop per option, optional min/max limits that refuse out loud, and per-item disabled reasons.

items.name: skip-link
items.title: Skip Link
items.description: A hidden-until-focused link cluster that moves focus — not just the scroll — to a page landmark, clearing a sticky header by a configurable offset.

items.name: popconfirm
items.title: Popconfirm
items.description: A confirmation anchored to the control that raised it — non-modal, keyboard-complete, one-shot, with a pending state and an inline rejection that keeps the panel open.

items.name: pull-to-refresh
items.title: Pull To Refresh
items.description: A pull-down-to-refresh wrapper: a rubber-banded drag claimed only while the scroller is at the top, a threshold that arms the release, an async refresh held until it settles, and a keyboard-reachable refresh button.

items.name: infinite-scroll
items.title: Infinite Scroll
items.description: A sentinel-driven feed with four first-class data states — a failed page keeps every row already loaded, the in-flight lock is a ref so no page is ever fetched twice, and the manual trigger plus a role=feed keyboard walk make it reachable without a mouse.

items.name: swipe-actions
items.title: Swipe Actions
items.description: A list row whose horizontal drag uncovers real action buttons — resistance, velocity snapping, a full-swipe commit, a second press for destructive actions, and the same actions on the keyboard.

items.name: chart-sunburst
items.title: Sunburst Chart
items.description: A four-state zoomable sunburst in hand-rolled SVG — concentric rings whose sweeps compose exactly, click-to-zoom with a breadcrumb, keyboard-walkable slices and an sr-only breakdown table.

items.name: chart-chord
items.title: Chord Diagram
items.description: A four-state chord diagram drawn in plain SVG — entities on a ring sized by inflow plus outflow, bezier ribbons sized by volume, symmetric pairs or directed arrowheads, a keyboard-walkable ring and an sr-only flow table.

items.name: chart-violin
items.title: Violin Plot
items.description: A four-state violin plot that estimates each group's density itself — Silverman bandwidth, a quartile box inside the silhouette, prominence-tested peak detection and an sr-only stats table.

items.name: chart-ridgeline
items.title: Ridgeline Plot
items.description: A four-state ridgeline (joyplot) that estimates every row's density itself — one shared axis, overlapping curves, keyboard-walkable rows with a peak and median readout, and a pinnable median comparison line.

items.name: chart-parallel-coordinates
items.title: Parallel Coordinates
items.description: A four-state parallel coordinates plot for mixed-unit records — per-axis normalisation, drag-to-brush filtering that dims rather than deletes, draggable axis order, and a rank-correlation reading for every neighbouring pair.

items.name: chart-scatter-matrix
items.title: Chart Scatter Matrix
items.description: A SPLOM whose panels share one domain per variable, brushes a record across every panel at once, puts distributions on the diagonal and Pearson r on the upper triangle, and states its panel cap instead of melting on 20 variables.

items.name: chart-marimekko
items.title: Marimekko Chart
items.description: A four-state mosaic chart where column width is each column's share of the total and stacked height is its internal mix, so a cell's area is its share of everything — with a minimum-width floor, texture tiers past the fifth band, and labels that drop out cell by cell.

items.name: chart-dumbbell
items.title: Dumbbell Chart
items.description: A four-state dumbbell chart — one row per category, two dots joined by a bar on one shared scale, ranked by valence-aware change with direction carried by shape, arrow and row order as well as colour.

items.name: chart-stream
items.title: Streamgraph
items.description: A four-state streamgraph whose bands stack on a wiggle-minimising baseline — inside-out ordering, overshoot-free monotone curves, a per-column readout and an sr-only series-by-tick table.

items.name: chart-bubble
items.title: Chart Bubble
items.description: A four-state bubble chart in plain SVG: area-proportional radii from a zero baseline, hue paired with fill texture for the fourth dimension, and an optional time slider that interpolates positions between snapshots.

items.name: chart-pyramid
items.title: Population Pyramid
items.description: A four-state back-to-back band chart — two cohorts mirrored on one shared scale, with per-side totals, an earlier period overlaid as dashed outlines, and every band keyboard-reachable with a readout.

items.name: chart-hexbin
items.title: Hexbin Density Plot
items.description: A four-state hexbin that bins the raw scatter itself — nearest-centre binning, sqrt / linear / quantile bands, colour paired with hexagon size, a live bin-radius control and a ranked screen-reader table.

items.name: chart-word-cloud
items.title: Word Cloud
items.description: A four-state word cloud that sizes terms by the square root of their count and packs them along a deterministic spiral, with every word a focusable button and a ranked list for screen readers.

items.name: chart-venn
items.title: Venn Diagram
items.description: An area-proportional Venn for two or three sets that measures what it drew and falls back to a labelled region table when circles cannot tell the truth.

items.name: chart-polar-area
items.title: Polar Area Chart
items.description: A Nightingale rose where every period owns an equal angle and the radius is area-corrected, drawing measured zeros, missing readings and below-zero periods each in their own way.

items.name: chart-radial-bar
items.title: Radial Bar Chart
items.description: Concentric arc bars — one ring per category on one shared ceiling, with a per-ring target tick, capped overflow, anticlockwise negatives and an sr-only value table.

items.name: chart-tile-map
items.title: Tile Grid Map
items.description: A grid cartogram where every region is an equal-size tile at a hand-supplied grid position, classed by quantile, equal interval or manual breaks — choropleth readability with no projection and no geographic data.

items.name: chart-burndown
items.title: Chart Burndown
items.description: A four-state sprint burndown: remaining work against an ideal that only burns on working days, scope changes drawn as steps, and a projected finish from a burn rate a descope cannot fake.

items.name: chart-cumulative-flow
items.title: Cumulative Flow Diagram
items.description: A four-state cumulative flow diagram that reads band thickness as work in progress and the horizontal gap between the arrival and delivery curves as approximate lead time, annotated on the plot and reachable by keyboard.

items.name: chart-control
items.title: Control Chart
items.description: A four-state SPC control chart that estimates its own limits from the moving range and flags every rule violation with the rule it broke.

items.name: chart-waffle
items.title: Waffle Chart
items.description: A four-state waffle (square pie) that apportions categories onto a countable grid with largest-remainder rounding, reserves a cell for shares worth less than one, and keeps the palette readable past five categories.

items.name: chart-arc-diagram
items.title: Arc Diagram
items.description: A four-state arc diagram in plain SVG — nodes on one sequence-preserving baseline, half-ellipse arcs sized by weight, back-edges below the axis, hover to raise a node's arcs, and a keyboard walk over an sr-only node and arc table.

items.name: multi-select
items.title: Multi Select
items.description: A multi-selection field: removable chips with a +N collapse in the trigger, a searchable checkbox listbox, select-all / clear, group headings, and a cap that refuses out loud.

items.name: checkbox-group
items.title: Checkbox Group
items.description: A flat fieldset of checkboxes with a genuinely indeterminate select-all, per-row descriptions, shift-range selection, and min/max limits that answer with a message instead of a dead control.

items.name: assignee-picker
items.title: Assignee Picker
items.description: A people picker with searchable presence-aware rows, a first-class Unassigned option, a recently-assigned shortcut group, single or multi assignment, blocked rows that say why, and four data states.

items.name: password-generator
items.title: Password Generator
items.description: A crypto-backed password generator with a length slider, required character sets, look-alike exclusion, a live entropy readout and an explicit refusal for impossible rule sets.

items.name: key-value-editor
items.title: Key Value Editor
items.description: An editable list of flat key/value pairs — drag or Alt+Arrow to reorder, switch a row off instead of deleting it, paste a block of Key: value lines, and see both halves of every duplicate key.

items.name: sort-builder
items.title: Sort Builder
items.description: A multi-key sort composer — ordered field plus direction rules, drag or keyboard reprioritising, direction wording that follows the field type, and a live plain-language summary of the whole chain.

items.name: activity-feed
items.title: Activity Feed
items.description: A grouped activity stream — consecutive entries that share a verb and a target fold into one line, with day separators, an unread boundary and four data states.

items.name: stopwatch
items.title: Stopwatch
items.description: A count-up stopwatch with start/pause/reset and lap recording, timed off a monotonic clock so laps stay exact and a throttled background tab never loses time.

items.name: calendar-month
items.title: Calendar Month
items.description: A month grid of events — multi-day bars packed into shared lanes, a "+N more" day peek, today and out-of-month cells distinguished, configurable week start and four data states.

items.name: timeline-swimlane
items.title: Timeline Swimlane
items.description: Events across parallel resource lanes on one shared time axis, with overlap stacking, hour/day/week zoom, a caller-supplied now marker and four data states.

items.name: dashboard-grid
items.title: Dashboard Grid
items.description: A draggable, resizable widget grid: widgets snap to a column grid, collisions push neighbours down deterministically, and every accepted change emits the whole layout for the consumer to persist.

items.name: column-picker
items.title: Column Picker
items.description: A table column manager: show/hide toggles, drag or keyboard reorder, pinned columns that refuse to hide with a reason, search and reset — emitting the ordered visible set.

items.name: type-scale
items.title: Type Scale
items.description: A living typography specimen: every step set in real type, its px, rem, leading and tracking read back off the DOM, with copy-the-token rows and a heading / paragraph / numerals switcher.

items.name: color-palette
items.title: Color Palette
items.description: A live specimen sheet for a theme's color tokens — chips grouped by role, values read back from the DOM, ink/fill pairing previews and one-click copy.

items.name: contrast-checker
items.title: Contrast Checker
items.description: A WCAG contrast readout for one colour pair — resolved through the live cascade, composited on a canvas, with AA/AAA verdicts and the nearest passing lightness.

items.name: undo-toast
items.title: Undo Toast
items.description: An optimistic-delete toast: the row disappears at once, a countdown ring holds the destructive commit, and hover or focus pauses the window.

items.name: toolbar-overflow
items.title: Toolbar Overflow
items.description: An action bar that measures itself off-screen and moves the actions it cannot fit into a trailing overflow menu, lowest priority first.

items.name: export-button
items.title: Export Button
items.description: An export menu for a data table — row scope, a column subset, a live size estimate on every format, and a row that generates, ticks or turns into Retry without the menu closing under it.

items.name: oauth-buttons
items.title: Oauth Buttons
items.description: A third-party sign-in row whose brand colours arrive as props — one provider goes in flight, the rest lock without ever going natively disabled, and the last-used one stays marked.

items.name: pan-zoom
items.title: Pan Zoom
items.description: A pan-and-zoom viewport for content of known size — wheel, pinch and drag anchored under the pointer, a fit / actual-size toolbar, and a full keyboard path.

items.name: prose
items.title: Prose
items.description: A typographic wrapper for CMS or Markdown HTML: token-only vertical rhythm, heading scale, lists, quotes, code, tables and figures, with size, measure and compact axes.

items.name: status-page
items.title: Status Page
items.description: A public status page whose overall banner is derived from the worst service state and open incident, with per-service 90-day uptime strips, timestamped incident updates and upcoming maintenance windows.

items.name: nps-survey
items.title: NPS Survey
items.description: A whole Net Promoter Score round in one block: a keyboard-reachable 0–10 scale, a follow-up question reworded per detractor / passive / promoter bucket, an optional contact-me box, and a one-submission-per-session thank-you.

items.name: invite-team
items.title: Invite Team
items.description: A four-state invite panel: a paste-a-list email field with per-address reasons, a role per invite, a seat meter that blocks over-allocation, undoable revoke and a copyable join link.

items.name: use-map
items.title: useMap
items.description: Map-shaped React state: set, setAll, remove, replace and reset over a real Map, with any key type, copy-on-write updates, no-op bail-outs and a never-changing actions object.

items.name: use-raf
items.title: useRaf
items.description: A requestAnimationFrame loop hook that hands every frame a delta/elapsed payload, with start/stop controls, an fps cap and automatic hidden-tab suspension.

items.name: use-script
items.title: useScript
items.description: An on-demand external script loader hook that reports idle, loading, ready or error and keeps exactly one deduped tag per src across every caller.

items.name: use-focus-within
items.title: useFocusWithin
items.description: A callback-ref hook that reports whether focus is inside a subtree — no flicker when focus moves between children, and it still flips off when the focused node is removed.

items.name: menu-bar
items.title: Menu Bar
items.description: A desktop application menubar — one click opens, hover then travels between menus, with submenus, shortcut hints, checkable rows and a full roving keyboard.

items.name: back-button
items.title: Back Button
items.description: A back control that traverses history when there is an in-app page behind it and follows a real href when the visitor arrived cold — so a deep link never dead-ends.

items.name: ruby-text
items.title: Ruby Text
items.description: Ruby annotations for CJK and phonetic glosses — parsed from an inline notation or paired arrays, with a parenthesised fallback, per-annotation alignment and leading reserved up front so hiding the readings never reflows the paragraph.

items.name: drop-cap
items.title: Drop Cap
items.description: The oversized opening letter, floated across N lines with its cap-top and baseline solved from the font's metrics — hangs an opening quotation mark and skips short paragraphs.

items.name: text-diff
items.title: Text Diff
items.description: A word- or sentence-level diff of two prose versions — one unified flow or two columns, with insertions and deletions marked by underline, strikethrough and screen-reader wording instead of colour alone.

items.name: payment-buttons
items.title: Payment Buttons
items.description: An express-checkout wallet row — availability decides what is offered at all, brand paint and marks arrive as props, and a dismissed sheet is never dressed up as a failure.

items.name: print-button
items.title: Print Button
items.description: A print trigger that prepares the page before the dialog opens — a cancellable async hook, a print scope class, and a restore raced between afterprint, the print media query and a timeout.

items.name: video-playlist
items.title: Video Playlist
items.description: A queue that sits beside your player — thumbnail rows with duration and watched progress, a now-playing marker, cancellable autoplay-next, shuffle and repeat, and a keyboard-walkable listbox.

items.name: avatar-upload
items.title: Avatar Upload
items.description: The whole avatar flow in one control — pick or drop, refuse with a spoken reason, crop square, upload with a progress ring and cancel, and keep the crop when the transfer fails.

items.name: file-icon
items.title: File Icon
items.description: An extension-to-icon mark — nine file families, a four-step size scale, tints drawn from your own tokens, and the extension printed whenever the type is unknown.

items.name: offline-indicator
items.title: Offline Indicator
items.description: An offline bar for apps that queue work — it names the changes waiting, proves reconnection with an injected probe instead of navigator.onLine, and replays the queue with a per-action verdict instead of declaring success.

items.name: session-expiry
items.title: Session Expiry
items.description: A sign-out warning that arms at a threshold before an injected expiry instant — live countdown, one-shot refresh, a closed state that says why, and cross-tab dismissal over BroadcastChannel.

items.name: help-center
items.title: Help Center
items.description: A support landing block whose search ranks titles, keywords and summaries, whose topic cards report honest counts, and whose zero result offers a topic or a human instead of a dead end.

items.name: referral-program
items.title: Referral Program
items.description: A four-state referral panel: the personal invite link with copy and templated share targets, tier progress counted from the referral list itself, every referred person with their stage and reward, and the program terms behind a disclosure.

items.name: app-download
items.title: App Download
items.description: A get-the-app block that promotes the store matching the visitor's device, encodes the smart link into a scannable QR for desktop visitors, and renders the store badges you supply instead of redrawing brand marks.

items.name: cookie-preferences
items.title: Cookie Preferences
items.description: A granular cookie consent manager: one row per category with plain-language copy and a vendor-count disclosure, a locked strictly-necessary row, equal-weight accept-all / reject-all / save-selection, and a saved-choice strip that re-opens the editor.

items.name: subscription-manager
items.title: Subscription Manager
items.description: A manage-plan block — the running plan with its renewal countdown and seat overage, usage against the plan's own limits, prorated plan changes, and a cancellation that states what is lost and when access actually ends.

items.name: cascading-select
items.title: Cascading Select
items.description: Dependent selects — country then region then city: each rung loads from the one above, changing an upper rung clears the lower ones out loud, and an answer for a rung the reader already left is discarded.

items.name: business-hours
items.title: Business Hours
items.description: A weekly opening-hours editor — per-day open/closed switches, split shifts, blocks that cross midnight, overlap detection that follows the spill into the next day, and a plain-language summary.

items.name: avatar-status
items.title: Avatar Status
items.description: One avatar carrying its own state — initials derived from the name, a presence ring whose word joins the accessible name, a corner badge slot, five sizes and a circle or squircle frame.

items.name: barcode
items.title: Barcode
items.description: A vector Code 128 / EAN-13 renderer — automatic subset switching, a real check digit, spec quiet zones, and a refusal that names what cannot be encoded.

items.name: world-clock
items.title: World Clock
items.description: Several time zones on one card — rows ticking on one shared minute timer, with Intl-derived offsets and DST, yesterday/tomorrow markers, and a working-hours band that shows the overlap with your own day.

items.name: use-prefers-reduced-motion
items.title: usePrefersReducedMotion
items.description: An SSR-safe hook that reports whether the user has asked the system to reduce motion, and updates live when the OS setting changes.

items.name: use-cookie
items.title: useCookie
items.description: A cookie-as-state hook with typed attributes, cross-instance sync, an SSR-safe default snapshot, and writes that refuse instead of silently vanishing over the 4 KB cap.

items.name: use-retry
items.title: useRetry
items.description: A retry loop for one async call: exponential backoff with full jitter, a shouldRetry predicate, a live countdown to the next attempt, and cancellation that clears every timer.

items.name: use-poll
items.title: usePoll
items.description: A polling hook that pauses in hidden tabs, catches up on return, skips a tick while a request is still in flight, and backs off through a dynamic interval.

items.name: use-visual-viewport
items.title: useVisualViewport
items.description: A hook that tracks the visual viewport — size, offsets and pinch scale — and derives the keyboard occlusion so a bottom bar can sit above the on-screen keyboard.

items.name: use-network-info
items.title: useNetworkInfo
items.description: A useSyncExternalStore hook that reports connection quality rather than reachability — effectiveType, downlink, rtt and saveData normalised to nullable fields, plus one coarse quality label.

items.name: use-battery
items.title: useBattery
items.description: Reads battery level, charging state and time remaining from the Battery Status API, with a four-way support status and a low-power flag that fails open when no reading is available.

items.name: use-vibrate
items.title: useVibrate
items.description: A Vibration API hook that plays a normalized haptic pattern from a user gesture, names every refusal instead of failing silently, honours a page-wide haptics mute, and cancels the pattern it owns on unmount.

items.name: matrix-rain
items.title: Matrix Rain
items.description: Falling glyph columns on one canvas — every column keeps its own speed, length and bright head, and glyphs swap in place so the stream reads as changing rather than scrolling.

items.name: rain
items.title: Rain
items.description: Layered canvas rainfall — parallax sheets of streaks sheared by a wind prop, landing as ripples on an implied ground line.

items.name: snow
items.title: Snow
items.description: Canvas snowfall with per-flake sway, a foreground-bokeh depth ramp, and an optional drift that builds along the bottom edge and settles under its own angle of repose.

items.name: fireflies
items.title: Fireflies
items.description: Wandering points of light on one canvas — each walks its own eased random path and flashes on its own period, with the glow blitted from a sprite baked once instead of a per-frame gradient.

items.name: constellation
items.title: Constellation
items.description: A drifting node network on one canvas — every pair closer than the link threshold is stroked with distance-faded opacity, queried through a spatial grid, with optional pointer attraction.

items.name: lightning
items.title: Lightning
items.description: Branching bolts struck at irregular intervals on one canvas - midpoint-displacement channels with recursive forks, a stacked glow, a decaying afterimage and a flash that lifts the whole surface.

items.name: plasma
items.title: Plasma
items.description: The demoscene plasma field on one canvas — sines summed over x, y and time through a cyclic token palette, evaluated at low resolution and upscaled so full-bleed stays cheap.

items.name: smoke
items.title: Smoke
items.description: Rising turbulent smoke on one canvas — three scales of a single baked fBm tile, warped per band and thinning with height.

items.name: vortex
items.title: Vortex
items.description: A canvas vortex — particles spiral into one point, winding faster as they fall, with comet tails made by fading the buffer instead of storing a path.

items.name: silk
items.title: Silk
items.description: Flowing bands of light on one inline SVG — stacked sine ribbons, each a soft gradient between two chart tokens, drifting slowly enough to read as fabric.

items.name: sonar
items.title: Sonar
items.description: A canvas radar sweep — a rotating wedge with a decaying tail over concentric range rings, and prop-driven contacts that flare when the beam passes and fade until the next one.

items.name: nebula
items.title: Nebula
items.description: A layered interstellar cloud on canvas — token-tinted noise octaves drifting at different rates under a sparse star layer, with depth from parallax.

items.name: ink
items.title: Ink
items.description: Drops of ink opening into water on one canvas — ragged fronts that expand, thin and dissolve, with every overlap deepening like ink on paper.

items.name: prism
items.title: Prism
items.description: One beam split at an implied prism edge into a slowly drifting fan of token-coloured bands — additive light on dark surfaces, subtractive ink on light ones.

items.name: galaxy
items.title: Galaxy
items.description: A spiral galaxy on one canvas — stars threaded onto logarithmic arms, a disc that rotates differentially, and a bright core, all painted in your theme tokens.

items.name: orbits
items.title: Orbits
items.description: Concentric orbital paths with bodies on real radii and periods — fading arc trails, a chord whenever two orbits line up, and one composed still frame when motion is off.

items.name: datetime-picker
items.title: Datetime Picker
items.description: A calendar grid beside an hour/minute/second ladder that emits one Date — min and max bound the combined instant, not the day, so the max day narrows the hours.

items.name: period-picker
items.title: Period Picker
items.description: A whole-period picker — week, month, quarter or year — whose grid changes shape per granularity and whose value carries the resolved start and end instants.

items.name: code-input
items.title: Code Input
items.description: A monospace code field with an aligned line gutter, indent-aware Tab, bracket auto-close, regex syntax tinting and error markers fed by a diagnostics prop.

items.name: matrix-rating
items.title: Matrix Rating
items.description: A survey matrix: statements down the side, one shared scale across the top, one native radio group per row, a pinned scale header, answered-row progress, and a stacked fallback instead of sideways scrolling.

items.name: pivot-table
items.title: Pivot Table
items.description: A cross-tabulation grid over flat records — row and column dimensions, sum/count/average, subtotals, a grand total, expandable row groups, and real loading/empty/error states.

items.name: flame-graph
items.title: Flame Graph
items.description: A four-state profiling flame graph — bar width is time, rows are stack depth, click any bar to zoom with a breadcrumb back, and a search that highlights matches across the whole profile with a matched-time readout.

items.name: code-tour
items.title: Code Tour
items.description: An annotated code walkthrough — numbered steps that each highlight a line range, show a note beside the code, and scroll the active range into view, with prev/next, a jump list and keyboard stepping.

items.name: env-diff
items.title: Env Diff
items.description: A key × environment configuration diff — every cell judged against one baseline column, secrets compared by fingerprint so no value is ever rendered, and a live count of what promoting one environment into another would change.

items.name: data-list
items.title: Data List
items.description: A read-only key/value list that folds from two columns to stacked pairs on container width, with per-row copy, focus-revealed truncation and an explicit em dash for empty fields.

items.name: maintenance-banner
items.title: Maintenance Banner
items.description: A scheduled-window maintenance notice that counts down to the start, switches to an in-progress state with an elapsed bar, and clears itself once the window ends — every verdict derived from an injected instant.

items.name: unsaved-changes-guard
items.title: Unsaved Changes Guard
items.description: A three-way exit for unsaved work — beforeunload armed only while dirty, in-app navigation held through an injected navigate handler, and a save / discard / stay dialog instead of the browser's bare prompt.

items.name: progress-toast
items.title: Progress Toast
items.description: A toast bound to one long job — determinate or indeterminate progress, a live percentage in its accessible name, cancel while it runs, and terminal states that hold long enough to read with a retry on failure.

items.name: breadcrumb-dropdown
items.title: Breadcrumb Dropdown
items.description: A breadcrumb trail that measures itself and folds the middle segments it cannot fit into a dropdown, keeping the root and the current page painted at every width.

items.name: page-transition
items.title: Page Transition
items.description: A route swap wrapper that holds the outgoing view until the incoming one is ready, cross-fades or slides the change, restores each route's scroll offset before paint and moves focus into the new view's heading — reduced to an instant swap under prefers-reduced-motion.

items.name: onboarding-checklist
items.title: Onboarding Checklist
items.description: A four-state getting-started panel driven by a zod task contract — a progress ring whose accessible value is the count rather than the rounded percentage, rows that expand to a description and one real action, instructions that collapse themselves once a task is ticked, an honest time-left figure, and an inline celebration whose dismiss states where to reopen it.

items.name: feature-announcement
items.title: Feature Announcement
items.description: A what's-new surface — modal dialog or anchored popover — that steps through the features a reader has not seen yet and reports every seen id plus the reason it closed.

items.name: api-playground
items.title: API Playground
items.description: A try-it console that generates parameter, header and body editors from an operation definition, sends the request through an injected fetcher, and reports status, timing, size and headers with a pretty/raw toggle.

items.name: use-form-persist
items.title: useFormPersist
items.description: A form-draft hook that debounces values into a versioned storage envelope, offers the draft it finds at mount instead of hydrating it, and clears the key on a successful submit.

items.name: use-mutation-queue
items.title: useMutationQueue
items.description: A durable offline write queue: enqueue with an optimistic id that doubles as an idempotency key, persist it so a reload keeps the work, drain in order when the connection returns, and park a poisoned write instead of letting it block the rest.

items.name: use-drag-drop-files
items.title: useDragDropFiles
items.description: Turns any element into a file drop zone through props to spread — a dragenter/dragleave depth counter nested children cannot flicker, an honest drag-time validity preview, dropped folders walked into relative paths, and every refusal itemised with a typed reason.

items.name: use-locale
items.title: useLocale
items.description: An SSR-safe locale snapshot — resolved tag, IANA time zone, region, direction, first day of week, numbering system and hour cycle — plus memoised Intl formatters for date, time, number, currency and relative time.

items.name: use-media-recorder
items.title: useMediaRecorder
items.description: MediaRecorder as a hook — start / pause / resume / stop, a live duration that excludes paused stretches, a container negotiated against what the browser really supports, permission and unsupported as first-class states, and every track stopped on unmount so the recording indicator goes out.

items.name: vertical-text
items.title: Vertical Text
items.description: Vertical CJK writing mode — right-to-left columns whose length is a character count, short Latin and digit runs stood upright as tate-chū-yoko, kinsoku column breaks, and an automatic fallback to horizontal when the copy would not gain from it.

items.name: annotated-text
items.title: Annotated Text
items.description: Prose with notes attached — marked phrases carry a numbered marker, the note opens on hover or focus, and every note is also listed in full under the passage.

items.name: transfer-list
items.title: Transfer List
items.description: A dual listbox: two multi-selectable panes with per-side search and counts, move / move-all buttons between them, and a keyboard move that reports what travelled and where focus landed.

items.name: schema-form
items.title: Schema Form
items.description: A form generated from a zod object schema — a control per field type, required markers and every verdict read from that same schema, typed values on submit, and an explicit notice for the shapes it will not generate.

items.name: font-picker
items.title: Font Picker
items.description: A typeface field where every option is rendered in its own face — grouped sans / serif / mono / display, previewed with your own pangram, with system stacks always present and remote families fetched through an injected loader that reports loading and failure per font.

items.name: regex-tester
items.title: Regex Tester
items.description: A regex workbench with flag toggles, matches tinted in place under the caret, a capture-group table, verbatim engine errors, and a worker-backed time budget that survives catastrophic backtracking.

items.name: theme-customizer
items.title: Theme Customizer
items.description: A live design-token editor: a radius slider plus hue and saturation per colour role, previewed light and dark side by side on real controls, and exported as the :root / .dark CSS you paste.

items.name: streak-tracker
items.title: Streak Tracker
items.description: A habit-streak card — the live run with a tiered flame, this week as seven day cells, a spendable freeze wallet and an at-risk countdown, all derived from an injected instant.

items.name: pricing-calculator
items.title: Pricing Calculator
items.description: An interactive price estimator whose seat, usage and add-on axes re-derive the bill on every change — switching tier by itself when a cap is crossed, and naming the cheaper plan when another one wins.

items.name: audio-trimmer
items.title: Audio Trimmer
items.description: A waveform you cut on: two handles bound the kept region, everything outside dims, zoom follows the selection, and a preview starts at the in point and stops itself at the out point.

items.name: dot-globe
items.title: Dot Globe
items.description: A rotating sphere of dots on one canvas — lat/lng places or a Fibonacci lattice, projected orthographically with a dimmed far hemisphere, pulsing markers and optional drag-to-spin.

items.name: use-websocket
items.title: useWebSocket
items.description: One WebSocket as a hook: a four-state connection machine, jittered backoff reconnects gated by a shouldReconnect predicate, an ordered outbound queue that covers the outage, JSON with a raw escape hatch, and a heartbeat that catches sockets that are open but dead.

items.name: follow-button
items.title: Follow Button
items.description: A follow / unfollow toggle with the hover-to-unfollow reveal, an optimistic follower count that rolls back when the request is refused, and a busy state that never uses native disabled.

items.name: vote-buttons
items.title: Vote Buttons
items.description: An up and down vote pair with the score between them — exclusive directions, optimistic score maths where a swap is worth two points, and a rollback when the server refuses.

items.name: poll-composer
items.title: Poll Composer
items.description: A create-a-poll form — a question, 2 to 10 reorderable option rows, duplicate answers marked on both halves, an allow-multiple switch, a duration menu and a live ballot preview, emitting a typed draft on every edit.

items.name: calculator-input
items.title: Calculator Input
items.description: A number field that does arithmetic — type =2+3*4 or plain 2+3*4 and it commits 14, parsed by a hand-rolled parser that never calls eval.

items.name: coordinates-input
items.title: Coordinates Input
items.description: A latitude/longitude pair that reads decimal degrees or DMS in either field, re-prints between the two on a toggle, names the field that leaves ±90 / ±180, and splits a pasted pair across both inputs.

items.name: meeting-planner
items.title: Meeting Planner
items.description: Find a time across time zones — participant rows over one shared 24-hour track, a draggable column that reads the same instant in every zone, hour snapping with Shift for half hours, and working hours derived from Intl.

items.name: order-tracking
items.title: Order Tracking
items.description: A shipment tracking card — a four-stage rail, an ETA derived from an injected instant, exceptions that interrupt without colour alone, per-parcel tabs and a copyable tracking number.

items.name: live-cursors
items.title: Live Cursors
items.description: A multiplayer cursor overlay — labelled peer pointers interpolated between low-rate updates, chart-token colour per peer, idle fade, relayed click ripples and a spoken roster, with the transport left to you.

items.name: json-diff
items.title: JSON Diff
items.description: A structural diff of two JSON values as one tree — added, removed and changed keys marked by sign and wording as well as colour, changed leaves showing before → after inline, unchanged subtrees folded behind counts, and arrays paired by index or by an identity field.

items.name: jwt-decoder
items.title: JWT Decoder
items.description: A paste-a-token JWT inspector: header and payload as labelled claims, registered claims explained, exp/nbf/iat judged against an injected instant, and a permanent notice that the signature is never verified.

items.name: hexdump-viewer
items.title: Hexdump Viewer
items.description: A windowed hex dump whose offset gutter, hex pane and ASCII pane share one selection, with 8/16/32 bytes per row and copy of the selected range as hex or text.

items.name: spin-wheel
items.title: Spin Wheel
items.description: A prize wheel that reveals an outcome drawn somewhere else — weighted SVG slices, a flick or a button to start, ticking deceleration onto a pre-computed angle, and a one-shot settle.

items.name: currency-converter
items.title: Currency Converter
items.description: A two-way money converter: type in either field and the other recomputes through a rate table you pass in, with per-currency Intl decimals, a rate breakdown line and an as-of / stale note.

items.name: column-profile
items.title: Column Profile
items.description: A per-column profiling panel — inferred type, missing rate, distinct count and a mini distribution per column, expandable into percentiles, top values or a time span.

items.name: anomaly-list
items.title: Anomaly List
items.description: A triage queue for detector output — each row compares the observed value against its baseline band, states the deviation in σ or %, marks the point on a sparkline, and can be acknowledged, ignored or called a false positive.

items.name: threshold-editor
items.title: Threshold Editor
items.description: An alert rule editor where every rule is metric + comparison + threshold + a sustained duration + severity — and each one is replayed against recorded samples, so the number of pages it would have produced is on screen before anyone saves.

items.name: run-comparison
items.title: Run Comparison
items.description: A side-by-side experiment comparison — one column per run, hyperparameter and metric rows, differences lit up against a baseline you can move, a best value per metric decided by contract-declared polarity, and a frozen label column.

items.name: ab-test-result
items.title: A/B Test Result
items.description: An experiment readout that turns two conversion counts into a relative lift, its confidence interval, a significance verdict and a sample-size progress line — with every degenerate input handled as its own branch.

items.name: slice-explorer
items.title: Slice Explorer
items.description: A dimension breakdown you can drill: pick a metric and a dimension, rank every value by its contribution, click one to make it a filter, and step back through a breadcrumb — with contribution computed correctly for rates, not just for totals.

items.name: report-scheduler
items.title: Report Scheduler
items.description: A recurring-delivery manager for reports — frequency, send time, IANA zone, recipients and format per subscription, each row carrying its next run, and an editor that previews the next runs as real instants before you save.

items.name: data-diff-table
items.title: Data Diff Table
items.description: A row-level diff of two dataset snapshots — rows matched on a key, change kind derived from the data, and a missing field told apart from a null one.

items.name: social-proof-toast
items.title: Social Proof Toast
items.description: A rotating recent-activity notice: one entry every N seconds at most, paused by hover, focus and a hidden tab, with a mute control that reports back through a callback.

items.name: exit-intent
items.title: Exit Intent
items.description: A leave-detector and its surface — a pointer crossing the top edge or a fast scroll-up opens a dismissable payload once per session, and never over a field somebody is typing into.

items.name: passkey-prompt
items.title: Passkey Prompt
items.description: A passkey enrolment card that asks the device what it can do before offering anything, runs the WebAuthn ceremony you inject through an AbortSignal, and treats a closed sheet as a retriable answer instead of an error.

items.name: product-gallery
items.title: Product Gallery
items.description: A thumbnail rail driving one stage — pointer-tracked and keyboard-pannable magnification, inline video entries with duration chips, and a layout that follows its container.

items.name: stories-viewer
items.title: Stories Viewer
items.description: A story-format viewer — one segmented progress bar per item, tap zones for previous/next, press-and-hold to pause, and auto-advance across image and video stories.

items.name: swipe-cards
items.title: Swipe Cards
items.description: A two-verdict card deck — the top card tilts under the pointer, stamps its verdict as it nears the threshold, commits on distance or flick, and answers to arrow keys, buttons and an undo stack just the same.

items.name: scratch-card
items.title: Scratch Card
items.description: A canvas foil erased under the pointer, with a coverage threshold that opens the card itself and a Reveal button that does the same from the keyboard.

items.name: equalizer
items.title: Equalizer
items.description: A multi-band graphic equalizer — rotated native faders, a Catmull-Rom response curve through the handles, presets that glide, and a typed gain map out.

items.name: lyrics-sync
items.title: Lyrics Sync
items.description: Karaoke-style synced lyrics — an injected playhead lights each line, word by word where word timings exist, keeps it on the anchor until you scroll away, and turns every line into a seek target.

items.name: chart-combo-dual-axis
items.title: Combo Chart (Dual Axis)
items.description: A four-state bar-plus-line combo chart whose two axes are built from one shared row structure, so a zero reading lands on the same gridline in both units and no gridline is meaningful on only one scale.

items.name: chart-legend-toggle
items.title: Legend Toggle
items.description: A standalone, controlled chart legend — aria-pressed chips in a roving-tabindex toolbar, double-click or Enter to isolate one series, show-all / hide-all, and a guard that keeps the last series from blanking the chart.

items.name: chart-bar-race
items.title: Bar Race
items.description: A four-state bar chart race — rows re-rank by transform so an overtake glides instead of cutting, with play/pause, timeline scrubbing, speed gears and a declared top-N board.

items.name: chart-small-multiples
items.title: Small Multiples
items.description: A four-state trellis grid — one repeated mark per category, every panel on one shared y scale with a free-scale toggle that states its cost, axis labels only on the edge panels, and a measured column count that wraps rather than shrinking cells past legibility.

items.name: chart-beeswarm
items.title: Beeswarm
items.description: A four-state beeswarm that keeps every observation — greedy collision-free placement that never moves a dot along the value axis, grouped rows, hover and keyboard readouts per point, and an out-loud sampling notice instead of a silent cap.

items.name: chart-lollipop
items.title: Lollipop Chart
items.description: A four-state lollipop chart — one hairline and one dot per category on a shared scale, ranked, with an optional reference baseline and a second dimension carried by dot size or shade.

items.name: chart-icicle
items.title: Icicle
items.description: A four-state linear-partition hierarchy chart in DOM blocks — one level per row or column, length proportional to value, click-to-drill with a breadcrumb, honest label truncation with tooltips, and an sr-only breakdown table.

items.name: chart-horizon
items.title: Horizon
items.description: A four-state horizon chart that folds each series into stacked bands and encodes magnitude as depth of colour, so a dozen dense time series fit in a screenful — one shared band scale, mirrored or split negatives, and a column cursor that reads every lane at the same instant.

items.name: chart-punchcard
items.title: Punchcard
items.description: A weekday × hour dot grid — every Monday 09:00 folded into one bucket, dot area on a square-root scale, switchable size / colour / both encodings and the aggregation timezone stated on the card.

items.name: chart-alluvial
items.title: Alluvial Diagram
items.description: A four-state alluvial that re-draws the same categories at every reading — band width is how many members moved, one global category order chosen by measured crossing cost, and a retained / arrived / left readout for whatever you point at.

items.name: chart-error-bars
items.title: Error Bars
items.description: A four-state categorical error-bar chart: one point estimate per category with an interval whose meaning — SD, SE, CI or custom bounds — is declared in the contract and printed in the legend, tooltip and data table.

items.name: chart-regression-scatter
items.title: Regression Scatter
items.description: A four-state scatter that fits its own least-squares trend — linear, logarithmic or exponential — draws the confidence or prediction band beside R², slope and sample size, flags outliers by studentised residual, and refuses to invent a fit it cannot compute.

items.name: chart-marginal-histogram
items.title: Marginal Histogram
items.description: A four-state scatter plot with a binned distribution along each axis — three regions on one shared, pixel-aligned coordinate system, linked by hover.

items.name: chart-contour
items.title: Contour
items.description: A four-state 2-D density contour plot — Gaussian KDE on a grid, marching-squares rings drawn at highest-density levels, a live smoothing slider, an optional raw scatter underneath, and a hard sample floor under which it refuses to smooth at all.

items.name: chart-survival
items.title: Survival Curve
items.description: A four-state Kaplan–Meier card — stepped survival curves computed from raw follow-up times, censoring ticks on the curve, a log-log confidence band and a numbers-at-risk table pinned to the axis.

items.name: chart-tornado
items.title: Tornado Chart
items.description: A four-state sensitivity chart — one row per driver, low and high segments measured out from a base-case line that is never assumed to be zero, ranked by swing into a funnel, on an axis that is never forced symmetric.

items.name: chart-seasonality
items.title: Seasonality
items.description: A four-state seasonal decomposition card — one series split into trend, season and residual across three panels on one shared x axis, with anomalous residuals marked against a robust cut-off and undecomposable feeds refused instead of fitted.

items.name: chart-connected-scatter
items.title: Connected Scatter
items.description: A four-state connected scatter: both axes carry a metric, the stops are joined in time order, and direction is encoded four ways — a width ramp, pixel-spaced arrowheads, a start ring against a terminal arrowhead, and named endpoint labels.

items.name: chart-lift-curve
items.title: Lift Curve
items.description: A four-state gain and lift curve for model evaluation — a cumulative capture curve read against the random diagonal and the perfect-model bound, with key quantiles marked and degenerate inputs named instead of drawn.

items.name: chart-likert-diverging
items.title: Likert Diverging
items.description: A four-state diverging Likert chart — one row per question with the negative options stacked leftward and the positive rightward around a shared centre, a neutral band that either straddles the axis or steps out of the bar, a switchable percentage base and net-score sorting.

items.name: chart-axis-brush
items.title: Axis Brush
items.description: A time-axis brush: drag a window over a thumbnail sparkline and it emits that window for every other chart on the page to filter by.

items.name: chart-network-force
items.title: Network Force
items.description: A four-state force-directed relationship graph in plain SVG — a hand-written repulsion, spring and gravity simulation that converges and then stops, draggable nodes that anchor where you drop them, colour by group or by degree, and hover to light a node’s neighbours.

items.name: use-eye-dropper
items.title: useEyeDropper
items.description: The screen eyedropper as a hook: open() resolves to a typed outcome — picked, canceled, unsupported or failed — instead of throwing, with hydration-safe support detection, a one-pick-at-a-time guard, and an AbortSignal that unmount fires for you.

items.name: use-sound
items.title: useSound
items.description: A pooled Audio hook for short UI sounds — preloaded voices so fast triggers overlap instead of cutting each other off, a page-wide mute and master volume, every refusal named, and every element released on unmount.

items.name: use-worker
items.title: useWorker
items.description: Run a pure function off the main thread: the function is stringified into a Blob worker, every call is a promise matched back by id so out-of-order completions land on the right caller, transferables move in both directions, task errors reject without replacing the worker, and everything is terminated on unmount.

items.name: use-fps
items.title: useFps
items.description: A frame-rate probe that reports rolling fps over a sliding window of requestAnimationFrame timestamps, counts jank frames, and pauses instead of reporting zero while the tab is hidden.

items.name: use-text-to-speech
items.title: useTextToSpeech
items.description: The browser speech engine as a hook — speak/pause/resume/cancel, a voice list that survives the async voiceschanged population, word boundary events mapped back into your own string, and a cancel on unmount so navigation never leaves a voice talking.

items.name: cart-drawer
items.title: Cart Drawer
items.description: A slide-out cart panel whose money re-derives on every change — quantity steppers that refuse with a reason, an undoable remove, a promo field driven by the host's verdict, and free-shipping progress.

items.name: age-gate
items.title: Age Gate
items.description: A date-of-birth gate with three explicit boxes, a real calendar behind them, and a minimum-age rule whose refusal is honest and always offers a way out.

items.name: waitlist
items.title: Waitlist
items.description: A viral waitlist block: validated email capture, a joined panel that reports your place and derives the rest of the maths, a referral link worth a stated number of places, and a leaderboard teaser that pins your own row.

items.name: chart-treemap
items.title: Treemap
items.description: A four-state squarified treemap in hand-rolled SVG — two levels tiled by area, branches fenced and named, click-to-zoom with a breadcrumb, spatial arrow-key navigation and an sr-only breakdown table.

items.name: chart-calendar-heatmap
items.title: Calendar Heatmap
items.description: A year of days as one week-column grid — quantile or linear colour steps with the bounds printed on the legend, measured zero kept apart from no data, and every tile reachable by keyboard.

items.name: chart-gantt
items.title: Chart Gantt
items.description: A four-state schedule chart — lanes that pack overlapping work into sub-rows, an axis that follows the span from minutes to years, progress-filled bars, finish-to-start arrows that flag the dependencies the dates do not honour, and a now line from an injected instant.

items.name: chart-raincloud
items.title: Raincloud Plot
items.description: A four-state raincloud that stacks a half-violin density, a Tukey box summary and the jittered raw readings in three lanes on one shared scale — id-hashed jitter, keyboard-walkable rows with landmark announcements, and an out-loud sampling notice.

items.name: chart-dendrogram
items.title: Dendrogram
items.description: A four-state hierarchical-clustering tree where every bracket sits at the height its two sides merged at, with a cut-height slider that colours and letters the resulting clusters, folded wedges instead of dropped tips, and counted refusals for loops, danglers and double-claimed joins.

items.name: chart-tidy-tree
items.title: Tidy Tree
items.description: A four-state node-link hierarchy on a Reingold–Tilford tidy layout — contour-packed coordinates from a pure function, foldable branches, curved, elbow or straight links, either orientation, and a flat ARIA tree over the drawing.

items.name: chart-circle-packing
items.title: Circle Packing
items.description: A four-state zoomable circle packing in hand-rolled SVG — front-chain sibling packing with a verified smallest enclosing circle, area strictly proportional to value, zoom as a re-projection rather than a re-layout, keyboard-walkable circles and an sr-only breakdown table.

items.name: chart-voronoi
items.title: Voronoi Territory Map
items.description: A four-state Voronoi tessellation that derives territory from seed positions — half-plane clipping, an optional capacity-weighted power diagram, map colouring so no two neighbours share a fill, direct labels elided to the cell that holds them, and a lift on hover or focus.

items.name: chart-adjacency-matrix
items.title: Adjacency Matrix
items.description: A graph drawn as its adjacency matrix — one node set on both axes, cells carrying edge weight, reorderable by name, degree or cluster, with a row-and-column crosshair, directed or symmetric halves, and a foldable triangle.

items.name: chart-spiral
items.title: Spiral Timeline
items.description: Time wound onto an Archimedean coil — one ring per period, so the same phase of every turn lands on one radial line — with bars or dots on the coil, a floating zero baseline, measured zeros told apart from windows the series never covered, and a single-ring series refused rather than drawn.

items.name: chart-ternary
items.title: Ternary Plot
items.description: A four-state ternary plot in plain SVG — three-part compositions normalised to 100% on an equilateral triangle, with three gridline families, edge-rotated axis ticks, shaded classification zones and a keyboard-reachable mark per row.

items.name: chart-market-depth
items.title: Market Depth
items.description: A four-state order-book depth chart: mirrored cumulative bid and ask staircases meeting at the spread, an exact step outline, a hover and keyboard readout of price, size and cumulative total at any level, and a refusal when the book crosses itself.

items.name: chart-difference-area
items.title: Difference Area Chart
items.description: A four-state difference area: two series with the gap between them shaded, the fill and hatch flipping wherever the lead changes hands, and every crossing marked, counted and keyboard-reachable.

items.name: chart-pictogram
items.title: Pictogram
items.description: A four-state ISOTYPE unit chart: one row per category, icons repeated at a stated one-icon-equals-N scale, the last icon clipped to the leftover instead of shrunk, and unusable rows dropped and counted in view.

items.name: chart-qq-plot
items.title: Q-Q Plot
items.description: A four-state quantile-quantile plot that ranks the sample itself — ppoints plotting positions, a resistant quartile reference line, a pointwise order-statistic band, and tail departures named on the plot instead of left to the eye.

items.name: chart-roc
items.title: ROC Curve
items.description: A four-state ROC card — one curve per model with its AUC, the chance diagonal, and a draggable, keyboard-reachable threshold handle that reads TPR, FPR and the counts behind them at every cutoff.

items.name: chart-confusion-matrix
items.title: Confusion Matrix
items.description: A predicted × actual grid that reads as raw counts or row/column normalized shares, with per-class recall and precision margins, a hatched off-diagonal, and undefined rates kept apart from zero.

items.name: chart-calibration
items.title: Calibration Curve
items.description: A four-state reliability diagram — binned predicted probability against observed frequency, read off the diagonal, with Wilson intervals, a shared-axis count strip and every bin reachable from the keyboard.

items.name: chart-upset
items.title: UpSet Plot
items.description: A four-state UpSet plot for set overlaps a Venn cannot draw — a dots-and-lines membership matrix under sorted size bars, per-set totals on the left, and disjoint columns that add up instead of double-counting.

items.name: chart-ecdf
items.title: ECDF
items.description: A four-state empirical CDF that bins nothing — one step curve per group on a shared percent axis, percentiles read off the steps themselves, named crossings between curves, a keyboard-driven scan line and a vertex cap that states its own error.

items.name: chart-wind-rose
items.title: Wind Rose
items.description: A compass rose of directional frequencies, where each sampled direction owns its wedge, stacks its magnitude classes from the hub outward, and is read against labelled percent-of-total rings with calm counted in the hub.

items.name: chart-correlogram
items.title: Correlogram
items.description: A correlation matrix drawn half as coefficient-shaped glyphs and half as numbers, with non-significant pairs hatched instead of blanked and the axes reorderable by hierarchical clustering.

items.name: chart-biplot
items.title: PCA Biplot
items.description: A four-state PCA biplot that draws observation scores and variable loading arrows on one equal-aspect plane, puts explained variance in the axis titles, and states the arrow scale factor instead of hiding it.

items.name: chart-percentile-bands
items.title: Percentile Bands
items.description: A four-state percentile fan: nested p50/p90/p99 bands over time with the median line on top, an SLO rule whose breach stretches are interpolated, counted and keyboard-reachable, and an optional log axis for a tail that dwarfs the median.

items.name: chart-trace-waterfall
items.title: Trace Waterfall
items.description: A four-state request waterfall — nested spans on one shared relative clock, phase segments inside each bar, self-placing duration labels, an interval-attributed critical path ruled over exactly the stretch each span was blocking, and a collapsible tree the arrow keys can walk.

items.name: chart-climate-stripes
items.title: Climate Stripes
items.description: One stripe per period coloured by its distance from a baseline — a symmetric diverging ramp, a reference window that can be pinned so two strips compare, anchor labels, and unmeasured periods kept apart from average ones.

items.name: chart-event-timeline
items.title: Event Timeline
items.description: A four-state timeline of instants — one lane per track, a shape per kind, marks that crowd into one counted cluster instead of overlapping, brush-or-keyboard zoom into any window, and a now marker from an injected instant.

items.name: chart-renko
items.title: Renko
items.description: A four-state renko chart: one brick per box of price on a zero-anchored grid, time compressed out of the axis, hollow-up and solid-down bricks, two-box reversals marked, a derived-or-given box size, and a refusal when the box is too small to draw.

items.name: chart-word-tree
items.title: Word Tree
items.description: A four-state word tree that branches raw phrases out from a root term — ribbon width is that continuation's share, every word is a focusable button that re-roots the tree, and the breadcrumb walks back.

items.name: chart-vector-field
items.title: Vector Field
items.description: A four-state quiver plot on a derived lattice: one centred arrow per node carrying direction, length and colour, evenly spaced streamlines traced through the same data, holes that stay holes, and a keyboard-reachable readout on every vector.

items.name: scroll-shadow
items.title: Scroll Shadow
items.description: A scroll container whose edges dissolve wherever the content continues — all four sides judged independently, drawn as a mask on the scroller so nothing overlays the content or steals scrollbar width.

items.name: stick-to-bottom
items.title: Stick To Bottom
items.description: A scroll container that follows its own bottom edge — appended content stays in view, a scroll up hands the position over for good, and a counted jump pill brings the reader back.

items.name: lazy-render
items.title: Lazy Render
items.description: Defers mounting a subtree until it scrolls into view or the browser goes idle, holding its space with an explicitly reserved placeholder height.

items.name: virtual-grid
items.title: Virtual Grid
items.description: A hand-rolled two-dimensional window over a huge sparse matrix — only the cells near the viewport are in the DOM, with fixed or measured row heights and column widths.

items.name: sticky-stack
items.title: Sticky Stack
items.description: Multi-level sticky section headers that shove each other out or pile up, with every parking line accumulated from measured header heights.

items.name: safe-area
items.title: Safe Area
items.description: A CSS-only wrapper that keeps content clear of the notch, rounded corners, home indicator and landscape rails — per-edge opt-in, padding or margin, with a max() floor for devices that report no inset.

items.name: client-only
items.title: Client Only
items.description: Renders its children only after mount — the server and the first hydration render emit an equal-size fallback instead, so browser-only values (local time, localStorage, window) can never cause a hydration mismatch.

items.name: density-toggle
items.title: Density Toggle
items.description: A compact / comfortable / spacious switch that publishes seven --density-* CSS variables to a whole subtree, with a 24px target floor the compact step cannot cross.

items.name: announcer
items.title: Announcer
items.description: A screen-reader announcement centre — two always-mounted live regions, a queue that spaces messages out, an invisible marker that forces repeats to be read, and a timed clear.

items.name: dismissible
items.title: Dismissible
