items.description: A close button for any content that remembers it was closed — for this tab, forever, or until the copy is versioned up — with an undo window before anything is written.

items.name: overflow-tooltip
items.title: Overflow Tooltip
items.description: Text that reveals itself in a tooltip only when it is really truncated — a width probe for single-line ellipsis, a height probe for line clamp, and nothing attached at all when it fits.

items.name: char-counter
items.title: Char Counter
items.description: A grapheme-accurate character budget for any input or textarea — a warning band, an explicit over-limit state, a caliber prop so the count matches the server, and a hard cap that trims the paste out loud instead of swallowing it.

items.name: scroll-restoration
items.title: Scroll Restoration
items.description: Restores where each named scroll container was when a history entry was left, waiting for async content to come back before it lands.

items.name: anchor-heading
items.title: Anchor Heading
items.description: A heading that owns its anchor — a stable id de-duplicated against the live document, non-ASCII kept instead of stripped, a permanently focusable link that fades in on hover, and one click that deep-links, updates the hash and copies the absolute URL.

items.name: external-link
items.title: External Link
items.description: An anchor that works out whether an href leaves your site — origin declared as a prop so server and client agree — then adds an icon, the rel=noopener patch and a screen-reader new-window hint to the ones that do, and nothing at all to the ones that do not.

items.name: chart-3d-bars
items.title: 3D Bar Grid
items.description: An orbitable WebGL 3D bar grid — categories along X, series lanes along Z, height as value — with runtime chart-token materials, hover tooltips and four contract-driven states.

items.name: chart-3d-scatter
items.title: 3D Scatter Cloud
items.description: An orbitable four-state 3D scatter cloud on react-three-fiber — cluster-colored spheres inside axis grid planes, chart tokens resolved to WebGL at runtime and re-resolved on theme flips, with drei Html tooltips and an sr-only data table.

items.name: chart-3d-surface
items.title: 3D Surface Plot
items.description: A four-state rotatable 3D surface from a z-value grid — vertex colors lerped between runtime-resolved chart tokens by height, a subtle wireframe overlay, orbit controls and hover tooltips, with SSR never touching WebGL.

items.name: chart-3d-globe
items.title: 3D Globe Arcs
items.description: A four-state 3D globe with a graticule, value-sized lat/lng markers and elevated great-circle arcs between origin/destination pairs, coloured at runtime from the live chart tokens.

items.name: chart-3d-ribbon
items.title: 3D Ribbon Series
items.description: A four-state multi-series 3D ribbon chart on react-three-fiber — one extruded lane per series, theme tokens resolved into WebGL materials at runtime, hover isolates a ribbon.

items.name: chart-3d-donut
items.title: 3D Donut
items.description: A four-state 3D extruded donut on react-three-fiber — hovered slices lift and slide outward with a drei Html tooltip, the compact total floats in the hole, and a keyboard-focusable DOM legend mirrors the hover, all themed by runtime-resolved chart tokens.

items.name: chart-3d-network
items.title: 3D Network Graph
items.description: A four-state 3D node-link graph on react-three-fiber — spheres sized by degree, one line-segment pass for all edges, a deterministic golden-angle layout, hover tooltips, and theme tokens resolved into WebGL materials at runtime.

items.name: chart-3d-funnel
items.title: 3D Funnel
items.description: A four-state 3D funnel of stacked truncated cones whose radii track stage values, with orbit controls, per-stage conversion labels via Html, and theme tokens resolved into WebGL materials at runtime.

items.name: chart-3d-heightmap
items.title: 3D Heightmap Matrix
items.description: A four-state 3D lego-plot matrix — rows × columns of WebGL columns whose height and colour intensity both encode one value, with runtime-resolved theme tokens, orbit controls and hover tooltips.

items.name: chart-3d-radial-bars
items.title: 3D Radial Bars
items.description: A four-state 3D radial bar chart on react-three-fiber — bars ring a center with height encoding value, orbit camera, hover tooltips and runtime-resolved theme tokens, driven by one zod contract.

items.name: chart-shot-map
items.title: Shot Map
items.description: A four-state basketball half-court shot chart in hand-rolled SVG — NBA court lines in border/muted tokens, made shots filled with chart-1 and misses hollow, a per-shot hover tooltip with keyboard walk, and an FG% header derived from the same shots array.

items.name: chart-pitch-heatmap
items.title: Pitch Heatmap
items.description: A four-state soccer pitch touch-density heatmap in hand-rolled SVG — full pitch markings in border tokens, a zone grid shaded with one chart token at stepped opacity, a printed intensity legend and a direction-of-play arrow.

items.name: chart-pass-network
items.title: Pass Network
items.description: A four-state soccer pass network on a hand-rolled SVG pitch — players at their average positions sized by ball touches with jersey numbers inside, passing links drawn only above a count threshold, and hover or focus to light one player's connections while the rest dim.

items.name: chart-xg-timeline
items.title: xG Timeline
items.description: A four-state cumulative expected-goals step chart in plain SVG — two team staircase lines over 0–90+ minutes, emphasized goal dots with minute labels, a dashed half-time rule, and final xG totals in the header row.

items.name: chart-win-probability
items.title: Win Probability
items.description: A four-state in-game win probability chart in plain SVG — one line around a 50% midline, the band shaded toward whichever side is favoured in that side's chart token, key events pinned to the path as diamonds, and every readout reachable by pointer and keyboard alike.

items.name: chart-training-load
items.title: Training Load ACWR
items.description: A four-state acute:chronic workload ratio chart — daily load bars with 7-day acute and 28-day chronic rolling-average lines, and the ACWR on a second axis banded into a 0.8–1.3 sweet spot and a >1.5 high-risk zone, all rolling math computed from raw days inside the component.

items.name: chart-hr-zones
items.title: Heart Rate Zones
items.description: A four-state workout view that colors a session strip by heart-rate zone and totals time-in-zone into share-labelled bars, from bpm samples and zone floors.

items.name: chart-race-splits
items.title: Race Splits
items.description: A four-state race-splits spaghetti chart in plain SVG — every athlete's cumulative gap to the split leader against a zero baseline, direct-labelled line ends, lead changes and DNFs disclosed, and every split keyboard-reachable.

items.name: chart-form-guide
items.title: Form Guide
items.description: A four-state team form guide that ranks teams by points, with last-N W/D/L result chips, a hand-rolled rolling points-per-game sparkline on a fixed shared scale, and season totals per row.

items.name: chart-player-pizza
items.title: Player Percentile Pizza
items.description: A four-state scouting percentile pizza in hand-rolled SVG — one wedge per stat with radius as cohort percentile rank, wedges grouped and coloured by skill category, quartile guide rings, a rank badge at each tip, and keyboard-walkable slices with a shared readout.

items.name: chart-power-curve
items.title: Power Curve
items.description: A four-state cycling mean-maximal power curve on a log time axis — current period vs all-time best in two chart tokens, an optional dashed critical-power asymptote, and a pointer/keyboard scan that reads watts at any duration.

items.name: chart-elevation-profile
items.title: Elevation Profile
items.description: A four-state route elevation profile in plain SVG — the distance-vs-elevation area split into flat, moderate and steep runs by grade, labelled climb bands measured from the samples underneath them, and a hover or keyboard readout of km, elevation and grade.

items.name: chart-sleep-stages
items.title: Sleep Stages
items.description: A four-state sleep hypnogram with stage-colored segments stepping across fixed Awake/REM/Light/Deep lanes, plus time-in-stage summary bars with percentages, driven by one zod contract.

items.name: chart-fatigue-freshness
items.title: Fatigue and Freshness
items.description: A four-state performance-management chart (CTL/ATL/TSB) in hand-rolled SVG — fitness and fatigue as slow and fast exponential averages of daily training stress, form shaded around zero with separate fresh and fatigued fills, race-day markers through both panes, and a full pointer-plus-keyboard day readout.

items.name: chart-bland-altman
items.title: Bland-Altman Plot
items.description: A four-state Bland-Altman agreement plot that computes bias and ±1.96 SD limits of agreement from raw measurement pairs, drawing a solid bias line, dashed labelled limit lines, and out-of-limits pairs in the destructive tone.

items.name: chart-forest-plot
items.title: Forest Plot
items.description: A four-state meta-analysis forest plot in hand-rolled SVG — weight-sized squares with CI whiskers per study against a vertical null line, a pooled summary diamond, log or linear axis, and disclosed repair of dirty extraction data.

items.name: chart-funnel-plot
items.title: Funnel Plot
items.description: A four-state publication-bias funnel plot in plain SVG — effect size against inverted standard error, shaded 95%/99% pseudo confidence contours around the pooled effect, flagged outliers and Egger's test.

items.name: chart-pr-curve
items.title: Precision-Recall Curve
items.description: A four-state precision-recall card in plain SVG — one curve per model with AUC-PR in the legend, a dashed no-skill baseline at the prevalence, and optional muted iso-F1 guide arcs.

items.name: chart-rolling-average
items.title: Rolling Average
items.description: A four-state rolling-average smoother: the raw noisy series stays visible as faint dots over a hairline, the trailing-window mean is drawn on top, a ±1 SD band from the same window is shaded under it, and the window size is named in the legend.

items.name: chart-anomaly-timeline
items.title: Anomaly Timeline
items.description: A four-state anomaly-detection timeline: one metric line with the detector's flagged readings marked as destructive diamonds, anomalous stretches hatched, ribboned and counted, and an optional expected-range band the line is judged against.

items.name: chart-lactate-curve
items.title: Lactate Threshold Curve
items.description: A four-state blood-lactate step test in plain SVG — a monotone curve through the measured stages, LT1 and LT2 as labelled vertical guides, the three training zones derived from those two intensities and shaded, and an optional heart-rate line on its own right axis.

items.name: chart-gait-cycle
items.title: Gait Cycle Polar
items.description: A four-state polar phase chart of one cyclic movement in hand-rolled SVG — left and right drawn as closed loops around 0–100% of the cycle with the gap between them shaded, phase sectors labelled at the rim, and an asymmetry index printed signed as well as absolute.

items.name: chart-serve-placement
items.title: Serve Placement Zones
items.description: A four-state tennis serve placement map in hand-rolled SVG — the receiver's half court with tramlines, service line and centre line in border tokens, both service boxes cut into wide/body/T zones shaded by serve volume with one chart token at stepped opacity, each zone labelled with its count and win rate, and a hover or keyboard tooltip on every zone.

items.name: chart-pacing-strategy
items.title: Pacing Strategy
items.description: A four-state pacing chart for one athlete against a plan — diverging bars of the seconds each split banked or lost around a target baseline, the cumulative banked time overlaid on a right axis whose zero shares a row with it, and the finish read against the target.

items.name: chart-autocorrelation
items.title: Autocorrelation (ACF)
items.description: A four-state ACF/PACF stem plot that computes the correlations from the raw series itself — one stem per lag against a ±1.96/√n band, lags outside it carried by shape as well as colour, and a radiogroup that pairs or isolates the two panels.

items.name: chart-quantile-dot-plot
items.title: Quantile Dot Plot
items.description: A four-state quantile dot plot that turns a predictive distribution into countable outcomes — N equal-probability dots Wilkinson-binned into provably non-overlapping columns, an optional threshold that splits them, and both the counted share and the distribution's own probability reported side by side.

items.name: chart-decision-curve
items.title: Decision Curve Analysis
items.description: A four-state decision curve: net benefit against threshold probability, one line per strategy read against treat-all and treat-none references derived from the prevalence, with the useful threshold range banded and the leading strategy called out wherever you scan.

items.name: chart-poincare-plot
items.title: Poincaré Plot (HRV)
items.description: A four-state Poincaré return map for heart-rate variability that derives SD1, SD2 and their ratio from the raw RR series in the 45°-rotated frame, draws the fitted one-SD ellipse about the cloud's own centroid on a forced-square equal-scale plot, and forms pairs only from beats the recording's clock agrees are successive.

items.name: chart-sprint-profile
items.title: Sprint Force-Velocity Profile
items.description: A four-state sprint force-velocity-power profile derived from split times alone — a mono-exponential velocity fit over the measured segments, the linear force-velocity line it implies with labelled F0 and V0 intercepts, and the power parabola peaking at the optimal velocity on its own right axis.

items.name: chart-partial-dependence
items.title: Partial Dependence + ICE
items.description: A four-state partial dependence plot drawn over the ICE bundle it is the average of — one faint line per instance under the bold mean, a centred (c-ICE) toggle that re-bases every curve on the first grid point, curves that move against the average dashed and counted, and a decile rug showing how much training data supports each reading.

items.name: chart-learning-curve
items.title: Learning Curve
items.description: A four-state learning curve in plain SVG — training and validation score against training-set size, each inside a ±1 SD band the component computes from the raw per-fold scores, with the converged gap bracketed on the plot and classified as high variance, still learning, high bias or converged against a target line.

items.name: chart-body-map
items.title: Body Load Map
items.description: A four-state anatomical body map in hand-rolled SVG — mirrored front and back silhouettes whose muscle areas shade with one chart token at stepped opacity, hatching for areas nobody reported, leader-lined labels on the worst areas, and a ranked list with the front/back split and a flag line.

items.name: chart-hrv-spectrum
items.title: HRV Frequency Spectrum
items.description: A four-state HRV frequency-domain card in plain SVG — the power spectral density drawn as an area, cut at the exact VLF / LF / HF edges and integrated by the trapezoid rule into each band's absolute power and share, with an LF:HF readout, a normalised-units toggle, and the power that falls in no band drawn bare and counted out loud.

items.name: chart-drawdown
items.title: Drawdown (Underwater)
items.description: A four-state underwater drawdown chart in plain SVG — percent below the running peak hanging from a zero line, each dip shaded with its trough marked, a labelled max-drawdown call-out, and a recovery read-out that flags what is still under water, all derived from a raw level series.

items.name: chart-tennis-depth-zones
items.title: Groundstroke Depth Zones
items.description: A four-state tennis groundstroke landing map in hand-rolled SVG — the opponent's half drawn in ITF metres and cut into short / mid-court / deep bands across the left, middle and right thirds, every zone shaded by volume with one chart token at stepped opacity and labelled with its count and share, headline reads for the percentage landing beyond the service box and in the middle third, raw landings drawn as dots at their own coordinates, and a forehand / backhand filter that re-derives every number.

items.name: chart-tennis-court-coverage
items.title: Court Coverage
items.description: A four-state tennis court-coverage map in hand-rolled SVG — the player's own half with tracked positions binned into a dwell-density field on a grid cut from the court's own lines, the weighted average position and the median recovery spot marked at their exact metre coordinates, a signed baseline-distance headline, a left/right balance bar and a keyboard-driven depth-band filter.

items.name: chart-rally-length-outcome
items.title: Rally Length Outcome
items.description: A four-state rally-length chart in hand-rolled SVG — points banded by shot count (pre-aggregated or binned from raw per-point shot counts), each band a bar split into points won and lost on a volume scale, the band's win rate as a dot on a fixed 0–100% scale sharing the same gridlines, the busiest band called out and a one-line verdict naming where points are won and leaked.

items.name: chart-serve-miss-map
items.title: Serve Miss Map
items.description: A four-state tennis serve fault map in hand-rolled SVG — both service boxes with a net band on their front edge and net / wide / long miss channels outside the lines, each shaded on one shared count ladder and labelled with its count and share, first serves and double faults in separate panels.

items.name: chart-winners-errors
items.title: Winners vs Errors
items.description: A four-state tennis winners-and-errors ledger — one diverging bar per shot group with winners running right in a chart token, unforced errors left in the destructive token and forced errors extending the same bar as a solid muted segment, on one shared symmetric scale with a parity tick at each row's unforced count, the winners-per-unforced ratio per group and pooled overall, and the leakiest group called out above a sample floor.

items.name: chart-return-depth
items.title: Return Depth
items.description: A four-state tennis return-of-serve chart in hand-rolled SVG — returns grouped into depth bands laid out proportionally to real court metres, one bar per serve answered, the points-won rate per band overlaid on a fixed 0-100% axis, an average-depth caret placed at its own metre value over a scale court strip, and a written verdict on whether depth converts.

items.name: chart-tennis-score-grid
items.title: Match Score Grid
items.description: A four-state tennis scoreboard rendered as a chart in plain HTML — one row per set and one cell per game in the order played, each cell's upper/lower half marking who won it while an outline means the serve was held, a solid fill means it was broken and a "TB" tag marks a tiebreak, with set scores (bracketed mini-score included), hold percentages, unfinished sets and retirements all counted from the same games array.

items.name: chart-momentum-run
items.title: Point Momentum Run
items.description: A four-state point-by-point tennis momentum strip in hand-rolled SVG — one tick per point above or below the centre line, consecutive points by the same player merged into run blocks whose width is the streak length, break points drawn as taller ticks, breaks of serve as capped full-height hairlines, set dividers with a derived game score under each set, and the longest run per player printed.

items.name: chart-shot-speed-spin
items.title: Speed vs Spin
items.description: A four-state tennis shot scatter in hand-rolled SVG: every tracked shot plotted at its own measured speed and spin, coloured by stroke from a fixed chart token, cut into four playing-style quadrants by the player's own median crosshair, with per-stroke median crosses, outcome-shaped marks and a legend of aria-pressed toggles that re-centres the split.

items.name: chart-contact-height
items.title: Contact Height
items.description: A four-state contact-height chart in hand-rolled SVG — one stepped density ridge per wing on a shared centimetre axis, strike-zone tiers cut from the player's own standing height, the 91.4 cm net cord marked, the ideal-window share printed per wing and a call-out when a wing is being struck below the knee too often.

items.name: chart-shot-direction-flow
items.title: Shot Direction Flow
items.description: A four-state tennis shot-direction map in hand-rolled SVG — curved arrows run from three contact corridors on the player's baseline to three landing corridors across the net, thickness carrying the shot count and a diverging chart-token ramp carrying each pattern's win rate against the player's own average, with the most-used and the most-effective line named.

items.name: chart-net-clearance
items.title: Net Clearance
items.description: A four-state tennis net-clearance chart in hand-rolled SVG: a side elevation with the net drawn to scale at the left, every tracked shot one mark placed by the height it passed the cord against the depth it landed, the coached clearance window banded, netted balls stacked on the net in the destructive token, median crosshairs, a forehand/backhand filter and a screen-reader depth-zone table.

items.name: chart-break-point-ledger
items.title: Break Point Ledger
items.description: A four-state break-point ledger for a tennis match — one track bar per player per set showing chances vs converted with conversion labels, a match totals row and per-bar hover detail.

items.name: chart-pressure-points
items.title: Pressure Points
items.description: A four-state pressure-points chart — win rate on break points, game points, deuce and tiebreaks as lollipops anchored to the player's overall baseline, low-sample situations rendered hollow.

items.name: chart-match-stats-mirror
items.title: Match Stats Mirror
items.description: A four-state broadcast-style match stats panel — mirrored bars for two players around a centered label column, count rows split by share and percent rows on a 0-100 half scale.

items.name: chart-serve-speed-bands
items.title: Serve Speed Bands
items.description: A four-state serve-speed distribution — first and second serves binned into fixed-width bands as overlaid stepped histograms with per-serve median ticks and a crosshair tooltip.

items.name: chart-net-points
items.title: Net Points
items.description: A four-state tennis net-points ledger — one 100% stacked outcome bar per approach type (won at net / passed / lobbed / error) with largest-remainder shares, per-group success rates and a totals bar.

items.name: chart-court-zone-winrate
items.title: Court Zone Win Rate
items.description: A four-state tennis court choropleth in hand-rolled SVG — the player's own half split into nine ITF-derived zones tinted diverging around a 50% point win rate, low-sample zones hatched.

items.name: chart-kitchen-dink-map
items.title: Kitchen Dink Map
items.description: A four-state pickleball dink map in hand-rolled SVG — the opponent's kitchen drawn from USA Pickleball dimensions, dinks dotted by outcome (in / too deep / net / wide) with per-outcome shares.

items.name: chart-third-shot-outcome
items.title: Third Shot Outcome
items.description: A four-state pickleball third-shot chart — drop, drive and lob rows pairing usage share with a 100% stacked won/neutral/lost bar, largest-remainder rounded, with per-row win rates.

items.name: chart-side-out-scoring
items.title: Side-Out Scoring
items.description: A four-state pickleball side-out strip — every service turn as a segment sized by points scored, colored by team and shaded by server number, with running-score marks and per-team summaries.

items.name: chart-court-position-ladder
items.title: Court Position Ladder
items.description: A four-state pickleball position ladder — points grouped by the deepest position reached (baseline, transition, kitchen) with won/lost splits, advance connectors and per-rung win rates.

items.name: chart-shuttle-landing
items.title: Shuttle Landing Map
items.description: A four-state badminton landing map in hand-rolled SVG — the opponent's half drawn from BWF dimensions, shots dotted by type in color plus shape, out shots hollow, with front/mid/rear shares.

items.name: chart-badminton-shot-mix
items.title: Badminton Shot Mix
items.description: A four-state badminton shot-mix chart — one 100% stacked bar per game across five fixed shot types with largest-remainder shares and an attack-share tick under each row.

items.name: chart-serve-spin-mix
items.title: Serve Spin Mix
items.description: A four-state table-tennis serve-spin rose in hand-rolled SVG — five spin families at fixed compass anchors, wedge area true to usage share, win rate printed at each wedge tip.

items.name: chart-t-dominance
items.title: T Dominance
items.description: A four-state squash T-control chart — one mirrored bar per game split at each player's share of rally time on the T against a 50% center rule, with game scores and a match row.

items.name: chart-padel-wall-play
items.title: Padel Wall Play
items.description: A four-state padel wall-play ledger — direct, back-wall, side-wall and double-wall rows sized by shot count and split won vs lost, with usage shares and token-stroke bounce glyphs.

items.name: chart-h2h-history
items.title: Head-to-Head History
items.description: A four-state head-to-head rivalry ledger — one row per meeting on a center-spine timeline with the score on the winner's side, surface chips in fixed colors, and a running tally with per-surface splits.

items.name: chart-return-position
items.title: Return Position
items.description: A four-state tennis return-position map in hand-rolled SVG — where the returner takes first and second serves relative to the baseline, with per-serve median-depth rules and inside/behind shares.

items.name: chart-season-results
items.title: Season Results
items.description: A four-state season results strip — one surface-colored column per event on a fixed R64-to-W round ladder, title rings, month ticks and a win-loss-titles header.

items.name: chart-front-wall-targets
items.title: Front Wall Targets
items.description: A four-state squash front-wall map in hand-rolled SVG — the wall face with WSF tin, service and out lines, strikes dotted by shot type in color plus shape, tin and out hits hollow.

items.name: chart-shuttle-trajectory
items.title: Shuttle Trajectory
items.description: A four-state badminton flight-path chart in hand-rolled SVG — a side elevation with median arc and p25-p75 band per stroke type over a to-scale net, landing marks on the floor line.

items.name: chart-rally-replay
items.title: Rally Replay
items.description: A four-state playable tennis rally replay in hand-rolled SVG — the ball tweens shot by shot across an ITF-true court with persisting bounce trails, play/pause, scrubber and speed control.

items.name: chart-movement-trail
items.title: Movement Trail
items.description: A four-state playable movement replay — one player's tracked path on an ITF-true half court with recency-faded trail, live distance and speed readouts, play/scrub/speed controls.

items.name: chart-serve-sequence-replay
items.title: Serve Sequence Replay
items.description: A four-state playable serve-placement build-up — serves land one by one into the service boxes with running in%, ace and fault counters recomputed at every scrub position.

items.name: chart-score-ticker
items.title: Score Ticker
items.description: A four-state playable tennis scoreboard — derives games, sets, deuce and tiebreaks from a raw point feed and replays them point by point over a growing momentum strip with derived break/set/match point marks.

items.name: chart-points-race
items.title: Points Race
items.description: A four-state playable pickleball points race — two staircase lines race to 11 under side-out or rally scoring derived from raw rally winners, with leader tinting, side-out ticks and game-point marks.

items.name: chart-rally-elevation-replay
items.title: Rally Elevation Replay
items.description: A four-state playable badminton rally replay — the shuttle tweens arc by arc across a BWF-true side elevation, stroke types in fixed colors and dashes, past arcs fading to muted trails.

items.name: chart-coverage-heat-replay
items.title: Coverage Heat Replay
items.description: A four-state playable coverage heatmap — presence-time heat accumulates over a scrubbable match clock on an ITF-true half court, with set markers and stable full-match opacity steps.

items.name: chart-bracket-replay
items.title: Bracket Replay
items.description: A four-state playable knockout bracket — a 16-entrant draw revealed round by round with seed-aware upset chips, structural feed validation and a champion cell that fills at the end.

items.name: chart-serve-speed-replay
items.title: Serve Speed Replay
items.description: A four-state playable serve-speed replay — a dial needle kicks serve by serve while a band histogram builds beside it, linked by serve-number colors, with fastest and per-serve averages at every scrub point.

items.name: chart-t-battle-replay
items.title: T Battle Replay
items.description: A four-state playable squash T battle — two tracked players move on a WSF-true floor plan while T-control time accrues into a live share bar, with rally-end ticks on the scrubber.

items.name: chart-soccer-pass-network
items.title: Soccer Pass Network
items.description: A replayable soccer pass network in hand-rolled SVG — raw completed passes cut into match windows, a disc at each player's average position sized by involvements, lines weighted by passes exchanged, and a play / pause / step / scrub transport running on a real match clock.

items.name: chart-soccer-xg-race
items.title: Soccer xG Race
items.description: A four-state expected-goals race replayed on the match clock — cumulative xG staircases that grow only as far as the playhead, with real transport buttons, a running scoreline and goal chips that jump the clock.

items.name: chart-soccer-territory-flow
items.title: Soccer Territory Flow
items.description: A four-state replay of which third of the pitch a match was played in, minute by minute — a stacked territory band, a field-tilt momentum lane, jump-to-event markers and a play / step / scrub transport on the match clock.

items.name: chart-soccer-shot-quality
items.title: Soccer Shot Quality
items.description: A four-state soccer shot map that replays a match shot by shot — marks placed on the attacking half, sized by xG, shaped by outcome, driven by a real play / pause / step / scrub transport on the football clock.

items.name: chart-basketball-shot-zones
items.title: Basketball Shot Zones
items.description: A four-state NBA half-court zone chart in hand-rolled SVG — six rule-book zones tinted by points per shot against a league bar, replayed attempt by attempt with a real quarter-and-game-clock transport.

items.name: chart-basketball-momentum
items.title: Basketball Momentum Run
items.description: A four-state basketball momentum replay — the score margin as a stepped mountain over the game clock, unanswered runs called out as banded spans, timeouts and lead changes marked, driven by a real play / pause / step / scrub transport.

items.name: chart-basketball-lineup-stints
items.title: Basketball Lineup Stints
items.description: A four-state basketball rotation chart — one lane per player across the game clock, every shift drawn from check-in to check-out and marked by its plus-minus, with a play/step/scrub transport whose playhead reads out the live five in quarter-and-clock time.

items.name: chart-volleyball-rotation-wheel
items.title: Volleyball Rotation Wheel
items.description: A four-state volleyball rotation wheel that replays a match rally by rally — six slots in serve order, side-out % on the left of each slot and hatched point-scoring % on the right, driven by a play / step / scrub transport on a set-and-rotation clock.

items.name: chart-volleyball-attack-lanes
items.title: Volleyball Attack Lanes
items.description: A four-state volleyball attack-lane replay in hand-rolled SVG — tapered corridors run out of the setter's hands to each hitter and across the net, thickening swing by swing as the match replays under a set / score / rotation transport.

items.name: chart-baseball-strike-zone
items.title: Baseball Strike Zone
items.description: A four-state strike zone from the catcher's view — pitch type by colour, outcome by shape, called-strike-chance shading, and a transport that replays the at-bat pitch by pitch with the count moving as it goes.

items.name: chart-baseball-spray
items.title: Baseball Spray Chart
items.description: A batted-ball spray chart on a to-scale field — direction and distance from home plate, outcome by shape, and a transport that replays a stretch of games ball by ball while the running line fills in.

items.name: chart-baseball-win-probability
items.title: Baseball Win Probability
items.description: A four-state baseball win probability replay — a stepped line over the half-inning axis with leverage shading behind it, key plays called out by the swing they were worth, driven by a real play / pause / step / scrub transport.

items.name: chart-hockey-rink-shots
items.title: Hockey Rink Shots
items.description: A four-state full-sheet hockey shot map in hand-rolled SVG — danger zones from the slot outward, marks that carry the team in colour and the outcome in shape, period-and-clock playback, and a shot-attempt differential rail under the ice.

items.name: chart-cricket-wagon-wheel
items.title: Cricket Wagon Wheel
items.description: A playable cricket wagon wheel in hand-rolled SVG — every scoring shot drawn from the striker's stumps out to where the ball finished, coloured and shaped by the runs it brought, with the eight region totals riding the rope and a ball-by-ball transport clocked in overs.

items.name: chart-cricket-manhattan
items.title: Cricket Manhattan
items.description: A four-state cricket Manhattan chart in hand-rolled SVG — runs off every over as a skyline, wickets as drops under the axis, a cumulative worm on a second scale, two innings on one shared over axis, and a real transport that plays the match forward over by over.

items.name: metaball-blobs
items.title: Metaball Blobs
items.description: A gooey organic background — token-tinted blobs drift on seeded Lissajous orbits and fuse into one body through an SVG alpha-threshold filter, optionally leaning toward the pointer.

items.name: warp-tunnel
items.title: Warp Tunnel
items.description: A hyperspace speed tunnel on one canvas — seeded, tapered streaks leave a movable vanishing point and accelerate outward with perspective foreshortening.

items.name: progressive-blur
items.title: Progressive Blur
items.description: A gradual-blur edge treatment — stacked backdrop-filter layers with geometrically growing radii, each masked to its own slice of the band, so content melts into frosted glass toward one edge instead of hitting a hard blur line.

items.name: kinetic-headline
items.title: Kinetic Headline
items.description: A fixed headline with one rotating word slot whose width springs to each incoming word, so the rest of the line glides instead of jumping.

items.name: variable-font-scroll
items.title: Variable Font Scroll
items.description: A headline whose variable-font axes interpolate with scroll position, thickening character by character as it crosses the viewport and falling back to a static weight on non-variable families.

items.name: outline-fill-text
items.title: Outline Fill Text
items.description: Stroked outline type whose solid copy is wiped in by an animated clip-path inset — on scroll, on hover, or on mount.

items.name: text-clip-media
items.title: Text Clip Media
items.description: Display type whose glyphs become a window onto media — an image, a muted looping video or a token gradient fills the letters, leans away from the pointer, and degrades to a solid token whenever clipping is unsupported or the media never arrives.

items.name: custom-cursor
items.title: Custom Cursor
items.description: A container-scoped pointer replacement: a spring-driven dot that follows the hand and opens into a difference-blended disc over interactive targets, hiding the native arrow only while the pointer is inside and never drawing on coarse pointers or under reduced motion.

items.name: cursor-trail
items.title: Cursor Trail
items.description: A canvas pointer wake that samples the cursor once per animation frame and draws it as a tapering ribbon, an evenly spaced bead chain or drifting sparks, each node dissolving on its own lifetime.

items.name: glow-card
items.title: Cursor Glow Card
items.description: A card whose surface and border light up around the pointer, with an optional group where the hovered card stays lit and its siblings dim.

items.name: holo-foil-card
items.title: Holographic Foil Card
items.description: A card surface that behaves like trading-card holo stock — an iridescent gradient sheet, a fine foil grating and a specular highlight all re-aimed from the pointer, with an optional tilt.

items.name: elastic-drag-card
items.title: Elastic Drag Card
items.description: A card you can grab and fling — it chases the pointer on a spring, tilts with its own drag velocity, and springs home or docks into a snap point on release.

items.name: magnetic-grid
items.title: Magnetic Grid
items.description: A lattice of tiles that leans toward — or away from — the cursor, resolved for every tile from a single pointer listener with distance falloff.

items.name: canvas-reveal-hover
items.title: Canvas Reveal Hover
items.description: A panel that reveals a seeded dot matrix on a canvas beneath its content — squares ignite outward from where the pointer or focus entered, and dissolve in a scattered order when it leaves.

items.name: split-screen-hover
items.title: Split Screen Hover
items.description: Full-height panels that share one row and rebalance around the pointer — the hovered or focused panel takes the width and opens its copy while the others compress, dim and desaturate.

items.name: parallax-layers
items.title: Parallax Layers
items.description: A depth wrapper — each child declares a depth and translates at that proportional rate as the container passes through the scrollport, with an optional pointer nudge, driven by one rAF-throttled listener and zero re-renders.

items.name: scroll-velocity-skew
items.title: Scroll Velocity Skew
items.description: A wrapper that leans and slightly scales its content in proportion to scroll velocity, then eases back to neutral the moment scrolling stops.

items.name: video-scrub-scroll
items.title: Scroll Scrubbed Video
items.description: A video whose playhead is driven by scroll position — a pinned section maps its scroll window onto currentTime with rAF-coalesced, readyState-guarded seeks, and falls back to the poster plus an ordinary play control under reduced motion, an unseekable source or a load error.

items.name: liquid-distortion-image
items.title: Liquid Distortion Image
items.description: A picture that ripples where the pointer touches it — an SVG feTurbulence + feDisplacementMap twin over the untouched original, masked to a soft lens that follows the cursor and settles back when it leaves.

items.name: image-accordion
items.title: Image Accordion
items.description: A row of tall image slices where the open panel widens to reveal its caption and link while the rest compress to labelled slivers, folding into a vertical stack on narrow screens.

items.name: coverflow-carousel
items.title: Coverflow Carousel
items.description: A 3D perspective carousel whose covers sit on an arc — the centre faces the viewer while neighbours rotate away into depth with dimming and an optional masked reflection — driven by one continuous position that drag, horizontal wheel and arrow keys all share, with a plain scroll-snap fallback under reduced motion.

items.name: pin-gallery
items.title: Pinned Scroll Gallery
items.description: A section that pins while its gallery travels sideways — vertical scroll drives a horizontal track of cards, with a progress rail, per-item snap points and a plain scroll-snap scroller when motion is off.

items.name: logo-morph
items.title: Logo Morph
items.description: One SVG shape that morphs between several logo or icon paths on a timer, on hover or from a controlled index, normalising the paths at runtime so their points pair up and cross-fading when they cannot.

items.name: wave-divider
items.title: Wave Divider
items.description: An animated section seam of stacked SVG wave layers, each re-sampled every frame from two counter-travelling harmonics, with an opaque front wave painted in the next section's own theme token.

items.name: scrollytelling-panel
items.title: Scrollytelling Panel
items.description: A sticky-media storytelling block: a pinned visual beside stepped copy, where an IntersectionObserver reading line hands the frame to whichever step the reader is on and publishes the active index.

items.name: sticky-footer-reveal
items.title: Sticky Footer Reveal
items.description: A footer that sits behind the page: the content is an opaque sheet on a higher z-index that the last screenful of scroll slides off a sticky-pinned footer, with an automatic in-flow fallback when nothing scrolls.

items.name: feature-hover-preview
items.title: Feature Hover Preview
items.description: A feature list whose rows cross-fade a preloaded media panel on hover or focus, marking the active row with a measured accent rail and falling back to media inline under each row on touch.

items.name: morphing-nav-indicator
items.title: Morphing Nav Indicator
items.description: A nav landmark whose active indicator is one DOM-measured capsule that springs between items and morphs its width and height to fit any label, in pill or underline form.

items.name: sticky-cta-bar
items.title: Sticky CTA Bar
items.description: A conversion bar that docks to the bottom or top edge once a sentinel element leaves the viewport, carrying a headline, a primary action and a dismissal that is remembered for the rest of the tab session.

items.name: line-draw-scroll
items.title: Line Draw on Scroll
items.description: SVG paths that draw themselves as the block scrolls through the viewport — lengths measured with getTotalLength(), dashoffset unwound per path, sequentially or in parallel.

items.name: mobile-app-bar
items.title: Mobile App Bar
items.description: A phone screen header whose large in-flow title scrolls away and crossfades into a 44px bar, with the bar's surface bleeding under the safe-area top inset.

items.name: dynamic-island
items.title: Dynamic Island
items.description: A notch-anchored live-activity pill that morphs between idle, compact, minimal and expanded presentations.

items.name: status-bar-mock
items.title: Status Bar Mock
items.description: A mocked OS status bar — clock, cellular, Wi-Fi, battery — that fills the safe-area band above a phone screen, with notch, Dynamic Island, punch-hole and flat glass.

items.name: notch-inset-layout
items.title: Notch Inset Layout
items.description: A screen shell that lays itself out from the insets the device actually reports — filling, passing under, or stepping away from the notch, island, corner arcs and home-indicator lane.

items.name: screen-transition
items.title: Screen Transition
items.description: A push/pop screen stack with an interactive left-edge back swipe, a parallaxing under-layer and a drag that stays cancellable until you let go.

items.name: thumb-toolbar
items.title: Thumb Toolbar
items.description: A bottom action bar sized to the thumb-reach arc: a hand-side overflow key that opens its menu upward, press-and-slide selection, safe-area padding and a full keyboard path.

items.name: reachability-pull
items.title: Reachability Pull
items.description: One-handed mode as a wrapper: a pull on the home-indicator strip brings the whole screen down into the thumb arc — sliding, shrinking or leaning into a corner — with a button, arrow keys, Escape, a tap and a timeout that all send it back.

items.name: list-index-bar
items.title: List Index Bar
items.description: An edge-hugging A–Z rail that jumps a sectioned list from one continuous thumb drag, with a magnified preview bubble, dot compression and a full keyboard path.

items.name: action-sheet
items.title: Action Sheet
items.description: An OS-style sheet of grouped choices raised from the bottom edge, with a destructive tone, a detached Cancel, drag-to-dismiss and safe-area padding.

items.name: context-peek
items.title: Context Peek
items.description: The long-press peek: the held target lifts out of a blurred page and its actions resolve under the finger, as a menu, an icon toolbar or an expanded preview card.

items.name: share-sheet
items.title: Share Sheet
items.description: The system share surface: a subject header you can pull down to dismiss, a swipeable recents rail, a 4-up app grid and an activity list, on one scrollable sheet with safe-area padding.

items.name: permission-primer
items.title: Permission Primer
items.description: A pre-permission sheet that spends the phone's one-shot system dialog on purpose — reasons first, a swipe or a button to refuse, and a Settings round trip that re-checks itself when the app comes back.

items.name: rating-prompt
items.title: Rating Prompt
items.description: An in-app review request that rises from the bottom edge, forks a happy answer to the store and an unhappy one into a private message box, and refuses to render once the remembered outcome says it has already asked.

items.name: app-update-sheet
items.title: App Update Sheet
items.description: A bottom-edge update prompt with release notes, an installed-versus-available comparison and a download state machine — postponable, or a required gate that refuses to be dismissed.

items.name: paywall-sheet
items.title: Paywall Sheet
items.description: A subscription paywall that rises from the bottom edge — plan radio rows, trial framing, restore purchases and the auto-renew fine print under a pinned, safe-area action bar.

items.name: filter-sheet
items.title: Filter Sheet
items.description: A bottom-edge filter panel with grouped facets, a staged draft, a live result count and an Apply bar padded clear of the home indicator.

items.name: long-press
items.title: Long Press
items.description: Press-and-hold on any row or tile — a ring, bar or swell charges under the finger, drift hands the gesture back to the scroller, and the completion fires exactly once, with a tap, a held key and a 44px button all reaching the same action.

items.name: double-tap-heart
items.title: Double Tap Heart
items.description: A media surface that likes on double tap, bursting a mark where the thumb landed while the first tap is left to the control underneath.

items.name: pinch-zoom
items.title: Pinch Zoom
items.description: A photo you pinch, drag and double-tap inside its own frame: fit is 100%, every edge is a rubber band, and the sideways swipe past an edge is reported to the host instead of performed.

items.name: swipe-pager
items.title: Swipe Pager
items.description: Full-width paged views under a horizontal drag — the deck tracks the finger 1:1, resists past the first and last page, commits on flick or distance, and reports position through a dot, bar or counter rail.

items.name: drag-reorder-list
items.title: Drag Reorder List
items.description: A touch list where a press-and-hold lifts a row under the finger, the gap opens live, the edges auto-scroll, and space plus arrow keys do the identical job.

items.name: swipe-to-reply
items.title: Swipe To Reply
items.description: A chat row whose sideways swipe arms a reply — the row tracks the thumb, a mark fills the gutter behind it, and past the threshold releasing commits and springs the row straight back.

items.name: amount-keypad
items.title: Amount Keypad
items.description: An in-app currency keypad that replaces the software keyboard — oversized live-grouped digits, decimal-point or cash-register entry, and a delete key that repeats on hold.

items.name: keyboard-accessory
items.title: Keyboard Accessory
items.description: The bar that rides on top of the software keyboard: previous / next field travel, quick-insert chips, and a Done key that hands focus back on purpose.

items.name: keyboard-avoider
items.title: Keyboard Avoider
items.description: A screen container that keeps its content and pinned footer clear of the software keyboard by the height the visual viewport actually reports — resize the frame, lift the frame, or ride only the bar.

items.name: wheel-picker
items.title: Wheel Picker
items.description: An iOS-style drum picker: scroll-snap detents under the thumb, optional wrapping, unlandable rows, and the same turns from the keyboard and two chevrons.

items.name: finger-draw-annotate
items.title: Finger Draw Annotate
items.description: Mark up a photo with a finger — pen, arrow and highlighter in a thumb-reachable dock, per-mark undo, a caret and arrow keys as the equal non-touch path, and a flattened PNG export.

items.name: mobile-search-bar
items.title: Mobile Search Bar
items.description: A phone search field that turns the screen into search mode — Cancel, a scope bar and recent searches — measured against the software keyboard and padded off the notch.

items.name: chip-scroller
items.title: Chip Scroller
items.description: A one-line filter chip rail that snaps under the thumb, fades at whichever edge still has chips behind it, and pins the off-screen count where it stays reachable.

items.name: inline-picker-row
items.title: Inline Picker Row
items.description: A settings row that expands in place to reveal its picker — slide a thumb across the options and lift to choose, instead of pushing a whole screen.

items.name: phone-number-input
items.title: Phone Number Input
items.description: A mobile phone field that regroups digits as you type, picks the country from a bottom sheet, and normalises pasted international numbers into E.164.

items.name: answer-metric-card
items.title: Answer Metric Card
items.description: An in-chat metric card for a phone — headline, delta chip and a thumb-scrubbed sparkline, bar row or intensity strip whose readout is hoisted into the header, out from under the finger.

items.name: answer-highlight
items.title: Answer Highlight
items.description: The conclusion of an AI answer stated first — four monochrome priority levels across plain, rule, KPI and icon compositions, plus a rail that pins the verdict below the notch once the reader has thumbed past the card.

items.name: criteria-checklist
items.title: Criteria Checklist
items.description: A live rule-satisfaction panel for a field being typed on a phone: a row per rule, a two-column grid, or a one-line summary of the next thing to fix — chosen from the keyboard height the visual viewport actually reports.

items.name: reasoning-timeline
items.title: Reasoning Timeline
items.description: A thumb-scrubbed reasoning chain for phones — the running node is called out on an inverted card, resolved nodes fold into a count, and the window never becomes a nested scroller.

items.name: chat-message-actions
items.title: Chat Message Actions
items.description: Hold one chat bubble and its quick reactions plus that message's actions come up against it — as an anchored menu, a compact toolbar or a sheet from the bottom edge.

items.name: hold-to-talk
items.title: Hold To Talk
items.description: A press-and-hold voice-message button: the strip takes over the composer with a live waveform, sliding up locks the recording hands-free, sliding toward the edge discards it, releasing sends it — and every one of those has a key or a button.

items.name: prompt-rail
items.title: Prompt Rail
items.description: A one-line rail of conversation starters that scrolls under the thumb and folds itself away — on a flick, on a key, or the moment the thread starts.

items.name: attachment-tray
items.title: Attachment Tray
items.description: The composer's + tray: a source panel that opens at the software keyboard's own height and pushes the composer up instead of covering it, driven by drag or button.

items.name: source-sheet
items.title: Source Sheet
items.description: A citation opened as a bottom sheet instead of a popover — the passage in the thumb arc, the cited line lifted clear of the sheet, and a way back to where you were reading.

items.name: stream-stop-bar
items.title: Stream Stop Bar
items.description: A bottom-edge run bar for a streaming answer — it mints the AbortSignal, stops the run from the thumb arc, climbs above the soft keyboard, and flicks away to uncover the text it covers.

items.name: snackbar
items.title: Snackbar
items.description: A bottom-edge message bar with one action, swipe-to-dismiss and a single-slot queue that never lets two share the thumb arc.

items.name: offline-banner
items.title: Offline Banner
items.description: A safe-area connectivity banner for phones that lists the changes waiting, sends them when the link returns, and can be swiped into a peek tab that keeps the count.

items.name: mini-player
items.title: Mini Player
items.description: A now-playing bar docked above the tab bar that a swipe up, a tap or a key morphs into a full-screen player, with safe-area padding and a read-only timeline when no seek handler is wired.

items.name: download-row
items.title: Download Row
items.description: A per-transfer mobile row whose rate and ETA disappear the moment bytes stop arriving, with pause, resume, retry and a press-and-hold cancel that answers to the keyboard.

items.name: sticky-section-list
items.title: Sticky Section List
items.description: A grouped mobile list whose section headers pin to the safe-area line and push each other out, with a thumb-arc pager that walks the sections and reports the one being read.

items.name: pull-menu
items.title: Pull Menu
items.description: An overscroll quick-action menu: pull a list past its top to reveal actions, the one under your thumb arms as you keep pulling or slide sideways, and releasing runs it.

items.name: map-bottom-sheet
items.title: Map Bottom Sheet
items.description: A map with a draggable sheet over it: detents, velocity settling, and a map that lifts its focal point by half of whatever the sheet covers.

items.name: passcode-lock
items.title: Passcode Lock
items.description: An app lock screen with keypad passcode entry, biometric fallback, escalating attempt backoff and a terminal locked-out state.

items.name: wallet-card-stack
items.title: Wallet Card Stack
items.description: A phone-screen wallet: cards overlap so only a tappable strip of each shows, tapping one lifts it to the top safe-area edge and tucks the rest under the bottom, and a downward drag — or Escape — puts it back.

items.name: chart-scaling-law
items.title: Scaling Law
items.description: A four-state log-log scaling plot that fits L = E + A·C^(−α) to the runs it is given — one power law per model family, with the exponent, the irreducible loss and R² printed, the stretch past the largest run hatched and projected, and compute shares apportioned so every filter state totals exactly 100.

items.name: chart-token-usage
items.title: Token Usage
items.description: A four-state LLM spend card: stacked bars split every period's tokens into input, cached input, output and reasoning, a cost line derived in-component from per-million rates rides a second axis sharing one gridline set, and the cache-hit share plus the money the cache spread saved are called out above it.

items.name: chart-attention-heads
items.title: Attention Heads
items.description: A small-multiples grid of causal attention maps — one miniature token-by-token heat matrix per (layer, head), sortable by row entropy or previous-token mass, with the picked head enlarged beside it under token labels on both axes and its attention mass split into four disjoint shares that add to exactly 100.

items.name: chart-embedding-projection
items.title: Embedding Projection
items.description: A four-state 2-D embedding projection in plain SVG: clusters wrapped in trimmed convex-hull blobs with numbered centroid badges, a nearest-mark hover readout that prints the item's own text, a cluster-versus-label cross-tab apportioned to exactly 100, and a derived caveat naming the groups whose between-blob distances carry no meaning.

items.name: chart-eval-leaderboard
items.title: Eval Leaderboard
items.description: A model × benchmark leaderboard: every column normalised in its own direction with the raw score printed and the per-column best marked, rank with movement arrows against the previous snapshot, and a weighted index whose whole-percent weights are apportioned by largest remainder and always total 100.

items.name: chart-training-runs
items.title: Training Runs
items.description: A four-state training-runs card: loss against optimiser step for several concurrent experiments, each drawn as a debiased EMA over its own faint raw trace, with divergence and restart markers that shade and count the steps a rollback cost, an optional learning-rate schedule on a secondary axis, and a scan that reads every run at the same step and only calls a lead when it clears the step-to-step noise.

items.name: chart-token-latency
items.title: Token Latency
items.description: A four-state LLM serving-latency scatter: time to first token against time per output token for every request, nearest-rank p50/p95 crosshairs, an inclusive budget crosshair that cuts the plane into four filterable zones, and queue/prefill/decode phase bars for the median and p95 requests.

items.name: chart-context-window
items.title: Context Window
items.description: A four-state context-window budget bar: the assembled prompt packed part by part, the reply's reserve subtracted from the window instead of stacked on top of it, the overflow framed against the budget that actually applies, and the tokens the eviction order takes first cut out of the part that owns them.

items.name: chart-cost-quality-frontier
items.title: Cost-Quality Frontier
items.description: A four-state price/quality plane for a model shortlist — the Pareto frontier drawn through the non-dominated models, dominated ones greyed and told which model beat them, and a movable iso-value line that names the best buy at the reader's own quality-per-dollar exchange rate.

items.name: chart-elo-ratings
items.title: Elo Ratings
items.description: A four-state arena ratings card: one line per model with a confidence band derived from its battle count, releases annotated with the rating move they produced, a standings ladder that flags statistically tied neighbours, and a pairwise win-rate matrix that doubles as the keyboard-navigable control surface.

items.name: chart-retrieval-recall
items.title: Retrieval Recall@k
items.description: A four-state RAG retrieval card: recall@k stacked over precision@k on one shared log-k axis, one line per retriever, with the shipped operating k marked and any measured k inspectable, an MRR@k readout, the per-query token spend of the cut, and a coverage bar whose percentages always total exactly 100.

items.name: chart-drift-monitor
items.title: Drift Monitor
items.description: A four-state feature-drift board: one threshold-banded strip per feature on a shared PSI/KL scale with the warn and alert rules drawn across every row, the prediction-drift lane on top, the worst offender named with its per-window trend, and a window tab-strip that re-reads the whole card.

items.name: chart-agent-trajectory
items.title: Agent Trajectory
items.description: A four-state agent-run timeline: every step a measured segment on the run's own clock coloured by kind, retries nested as attempts inside the step they re-attempt, generated tokens per step on a second track, and a wall-time-versus-generation mix apportioned by largest remainder so the shares add to exactly 100.

items.name: chart-data-mixture
items.title: Data Mixture
items.description: A four-state training-mixture card: one composition bar per training stage split by data domain, with per-domain epochs so upsampling reads as the gap between unique tokens and tokens seen.

items.name: chart-gpu-utilization
items.title: GPU Utilization
items.description: A four-state cluster-utilisation card: a device-by-time SM occupancy strip, one memory line per device group read against the HBM ceiling, and idle stalls drawn as selectable bubbles sized by their duration, with the idle share, the longest stall and a wall-clock budget totalling exactly 100% all derived in-component.

items.name: chart-tournament-schedule
items.title: Tournament Schedule
items.description: A four-state order-of-play sheet in CSS grid — courts as columns down a vertical time axis, every match a block as long as its estimate, not-before slots floating dashed at the earliest minute they can start, live matches filling against their estimate, and the double bookings, rest gaps and court-time shares the schedule implies.

items.name: chart-draw-path
items.title: Draw Path
items.description: A four-state draw path — one seed's route round by round with each projected opponent's rating, head-to-head and arrival odds that add to exactly 100, faint branches for whoever could arrive instead, and Elo win chances compounded into a survival bar.

items.name: chart-serve-plus-one
items.title: Serve +1 Patterns
items.description: A four-state tennis serve +1 chart in hand-rolled SVG — serve target, then the +1 wing and direction, then won or lost, as three stacked node rows joined by bands whose width is points and whose colour is win rate against a benchmark, with a deuce/ad radiogroup, largest-remainder shares and the most-used and most-effective pattern named.

items.name: chart-rally-pattern-tree
items.title: Rally Pattern Tree
items.description: A four-state rally pattern tree drawn as an icicle from the serve down — each row is the next shot, each branch is as wide as the rallies that took it and tinted by the win rate down it, with everything under the sample cut pruned and its share stated.

items.name: chart-surface-splits
items.title: Surface Splits
items.description: A four-state surface-by-surface record card — one win-loss bar per surface with paired service and return sub-bars, every lane on a 0-100% track carrying a tick at the player's own overall level, largest-remainder shares, and the strongest and weakest surfaces called out above a match floor.

items.name: chart-stamina-decay
items.title: Stamina Decay
items.description: A four-state stamina card in hand-rolled SVG — several match metrics stacked as small multiples over one shared elapsed-minute axis, each read against its own opening-window baseline, with a reader-chosen cut (end of set 1, 2, …) quantifying the drop-off in the metric's own unit and as a share of that baseline, a stated 1.5% noise floor before anything is called decay, and a minutes ledger apportioned by largest remainder.

items.name: chart-doubles-formation
items.title: Doubles Formation
items.description: A four-state doubles serve-formation card in hand-rolled SVG — a real tennis, badminton or pickleball court drawn in metres from the rulebook, a vertical tab list where each formation's row carries its usage share and win rate on one bar, and four role-coloured player markers that glide to the new stance when the formation changes.

items.name: chart-shuttle-speed-decay
items.title: Shuttle Speed Decay
items.description: A four-state badminton speed-decay chart in hand-rolled SVG — one speed-against-distance curve per shot type on an axis that follows the longest flight, each curve marked where the receiver's racket meets it (or where it dies short of the rule), with flight time integrated from the curve itself, a draggable distance cursor exposed as a slider, and a shot-mix column apportioned by largest remainder.

items.name: chart-deuce-ad-split
items.title: Deuce / Ad Split
items.description: A four-state deuce-versus-ad court split for one server — the same metrics mirrored around the centre mark, every row drawn as a rate of its own side's whole so two unequal samples compare fairly, mix members apportioned by largest remainder into exactly-filled 100% strips, wide gaps flagged toward the better half, and per-row disclosure for the counts behind each rate.

items.name: chart-tiebreak-ledger
items.title: Tiebreak Ledger
items.description: A four-state tiebreak ledger — every tiebreak as a point-by-point strip with the serve above or below a hairline and mini-breaks hatched, plus a selectable scope driving the tiebreak record, serve-hold rates and a largest-remainder split of where the points went.

items.name: chart-shot-tempo
items.title: Shot Tempo
items.description: A four-state rally-rhythm strip: the time between consecutive contacts mirrored around a centre line with one player per side, a rolling tempo band, flagged tempo breaks credited to the ball that bought the time, and a per-player tempo distribution across every rally.

items.name: chart-line-call-review
items.title: Line Call Review
items.description: A challenge ledger that plots every line-call review by the millimetres between ball and paint — both drawn at real scale — emphasising overturned calls, and tracking each player's per-set allowance spent against what is still in hand.

items.name: chart-match-workload
items.title: Match Workload
items.description: A four-state card for the physical cost of one match: distance and direction changes per set as paired bars on independent scales, a cumulative distance lane, and a tabbed per-set panel with work-to-rest and the average-to-peak movement speed range.

items.name: chart-partner-chemistry
items.title: Partner Chemistry
items.description: A four-state doubles pairing grid — one roster on both axes, the lower triangle carrying each partnership's win rate over its match count, samples under the minimum-match bar hatched out of the colour ramp and the verdict, each player's own average on the diagonal to read chemistry against, a per-player lens on the row headers, and a load strip whose largest-remainder widths always add to exactly 100%.

items.name: chart-point-leverage
items.title: Point Leverage
items.description: A four-state point-leverage scatter in hand-rolled SVG — every point of a match plotted by the win-probability swing it could produce against match time, priced either by a supplied win-probability model or by a standard table keyed by game and set score, with a draggable high-leverage line, the biggest points ringed and labelled with their score, and each player's conversion above the line.
